title_en: Land Mutation & Title Entry (Banglarbhumi vs KMC)
relevant_act: Sec 50 WBLR Act, 1955 (Districts) / Sec 183 KMC Act, 1980 (Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: Block Land & Land Reforms Officer (BL&LRO) / Regional Corps (BMC/HMC)
rural_steps_en: Submit Form 13 online on Banglarbhumi portal with registered deed and Khajna receipt. | Pay mutation fee online via the GRIPS treasury payment gateway. | Attend hearing before Revenue Officer at BL&LRO with original deeds and chain papers. | Download digitally signed Record of Rights (Khatian Porcha) from Banglarbhumi.
kolkata_authority_en: Kolkata Municipal Corporation (Assessment & Collection Department)
kolkata_steps_en: Apply online on KMC portal (Assessment-Collection) for mutation of Premises/Assessee No. | Upload registered conveyance deed, prior property tax clearance receipt, and Form M-42. | Chief Valuer/Assessor verifies ownership and inspects premises for tax re-valuation. | Pay prescribed KMC mutation fee and download Certificate of Mutation & Assessee Card.
overall_steps_en: Submit Form 13 online on Banglarbhumi with registered deed and Khajna receipt. | Pay government mutation fees online via the GRIPS payment gateway. | Attend physical hearing before Revenue Officer with original deeds. | Download digitally signed Record of Rights (Khatian Porcha) online.

title_en: Warishan Mutation & Inherited Share Entry
relevant_act: Sec 50 & 51A, WBLR Act (Districts) / Sec 183 KMC Act (Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: BL&LRO & Gram Panchayat / Regional Municipality (BMC/HMC)
rural_steps_en: Obtain formal Warishan Certificate from local Panchayat Pradhan or Municipality Chairman. | Submit online Warishan mutation application on Banglarbhumi uploading death certificate. | Attend hearing at BL&LRO; Revenue Officer apportions ancestral Dag/Khatian shares. | Download corrected Record of Rights (Porcha) reflecting legal heir proportionate shares.
kolkata_authority_en: Kolkata Municipal Corporation (Assessment & Collection Dept)
kolkata_steps_en: Submit KMC Succession Mutation Application with death certificate and legal heir affidavit. | Attach legal heir affidavit, family tree chart, and up-to-date KMC property tax paid receipt. | Attend hearing before KMC Assessor-Collector; tax liability recorded in surviving heirs names. | KMC issues updated Mutation Endorsement & Assessee Card reflecting co-owners.
overall_steps_en: Obtain formal Warishan Certificate from local Municipality or Panchayat. | Submit online Warishan mutation application on Banglarbhumi. | Present death certificate and legal heir consensus tree at hearing. | Obtain mutated Khatian Porcha reflecting proportionate co-sharer shares.

title_en: Land Conversion: Sali to Vastu / Land Use Sanction
relevant_act: Sec 4C WBLR Act (Districts) / KMC Building Rules (Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: District Land & Land Reforms Officer (DL&LRO / DM)
rural_steps_en: Submit Section 4C application on Banglarbhumi with site layout and adjacent plot NOC. | Revenue Inspector conducts field inquiry confirming land is not active waterbody/wetland. | Pay prescribed conversion fees via GRIPS treasury challan. | DL&LRO issues formal Conversion Certificate changing classification to Vastu.
kolkata_authority_en: KMC Building Department & Land Use Planning Cell
kolkata_steps_en: Verify land use zone under KMC Master Plan and Land Use Development Plan (LUDCP). | Engage licensed KMC architect to draft architectural building plan complying with KMC rules. | Pay development and municipal sanction fees at KMC Treasury counters. | KMC Building Department issues formal Building Permit and sanctions construction.
overall_steps_en: Submit online Conversion Application (Section 4C) on Banglarbhumi. | Upload site plan, Mouza map, up-to-date Khajna, and adjacent plot NOC. | Revenue Inspector inspects field to confirm plot is not an active waterbody. | Pay prescribed conversion fees on GRIPS and receive the Conversion Certificate.

title_en: Boundary Dispute & Demarcation Amin
relevant_act: WBLR Manual (Districts) / KMC Survey & Valuation Wing (Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: BL&LRO Demarcation Wing
rural_steps_en: Submit Demarcation Petition before BL&LRO with Mouza and Dag details. | Pay government survey and Amin fees via GRIPS treasury portal. | BL&LRO serves demarcation notices to all contiguous boundary owners. | Revenue Amin surveys plot using Total Station/chains and fixes concrete pillars.
kolkata_authority_en: KMC Chief Valuer & Surveyor / City Civil Court
kolkata_steps_en: Apply to KMC Chief Valuer & Surveyor for boundary alignment inspection. | If neighbor encroaches, file Injunction Suit before City Civil Court at Calcutta. | Move application under Order XXVI Rule 9 CPC for court civil engineer commissioner. | Court commissioner inspects premises based on sanctioned KMC building boundaries.
overall_steps_en: Submit a Demarcation Petition before BL&LRO with Mouza and Dag details. | Pay government survey and Amin fees via the GRIPS treasury portal. | BL&LRO serves demarcation notices to all contiguous boundary owners. | Revenue Amin surveys plot using Total Station/chains and fixes boundary.

title_en: Bargadar Recording & Eviction Protection
relevant_act: Sec 15 to 21B, West Bengal Land Reforms Act, 1955
overall_steps_en: Submit Form 14 before the Revenue Officer for recording under Operation Barga. | Provide proof of continuous cultivation and crop share delivery receipts. | Revenue Officer conducts local field inquiry with village Gram Panchayat. | Obtain Bargadar Certificate; eviction barred except under Section 17.

title_en: Correction of Porcha / ROR Recording Errors
relevant_act: Sec 51A(4) WBLR Act (Districts) / Sec 186 KMC Act (Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: Revenue Officer / BL&LRO Mis-Case Cell
rural_steps_en: Submit miscellaneous petition under Section 51A(4) before BL&LRO. | Attach original parent deeds and certified legacy RS/LR Porchas. | Revenue Officer examines volume register and conducts personal hearing. | Corrected Record of Rights is generated and updated on Banglarbhumi.
kolkata_authority_en: KMC Assessment Hearing Officer (AHO) / Chief Assessor
kolkata_steps_en: Submit written objection before KMC Assessment Hearing Officer (AHO). | Attach registered deed, building completion plan, and tax invoice showing correct area. | Attend scheduled AHO hearing at KMC headquarters (S.N. Banerjee Road) or borough office. | AHO issues rectified Assessee Ledger and amends municipal billing register.
overall_steps_en: Submit miscellaneous petition under Section 51A(4) before the BL&LRO. | Attach original parent deeds and certified legacy RS/LR Porchas. | Revenue Officer examines volume register and conducts personal hearing. | Corrected Record of Rights is generated and updated on Banglarbhumi.

title_en: Thika Tenancy Recording & Building NOC
relevant_act: West Bengal Thika Tenancy (Acquisition & Reg) Act, 2001
authority_forum_en: Office of the Thika Controller (Kolkata / Howrah)
overall_steps_en: Submit Form-A application before the Thika Controller with historical rent receipts. | Revenue Officer issues notice to State and conducts spot physical inquiry. | Thika Controller enters name in Thika Register and issues Tenant Card. | Apply for Building Sanction NOC before KMC/HMC via Thika Controller.

title_en: Right of Pre-emption by Co-sharer / Contiguous Tenant
relevant_act: Sec 8 & 9, West Bengal Land Reforms Act, 1955
timeframe_en: Within 3 months of notice; 1 to 2 years trial
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copy of the disputed sale deed from the Registry Office. | File Pre-emption Application under Section 8 WBLR Act before Civil Judge. | Deposit consideration money plus statutory 10% penalty into civil court. | Court passes order transferring title and directing execution of sale deed.

title_en: Illegal Waterbody/Pond Filling & Restoration
relevant_act: Sec 17A Inland Fisheries Act / Sec 4C WBLR (Districts) & KMC Act (Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: BL&LRO / District Magistrate / Fisheries Officer
rural_steps_en: Submit written complaint to BL&LRO, Local Police, and Fisheries Officer. | Authorities issue immediate Stop-Work Order under Section 17A Fisheries Act. | District Magistrate directs criminal prosecution and issues restoration notice. | If administration delays, move High Court Green Bench for excavation order.
kolkata_authority_en: KMC Environment & Waterbody Cell / High Court at Calcutta
kolkata_steps_en: Lodge immediate complaint with KMC Environment & Waterbodies Cell and local police station. | KMC Borough Executive Engineer inspects site and lodges FIR under KMC Building & Pond Rules. | KMC issues demolition notice for unauthorized construction on filled waterbody. | If police fails to act, file Public Interest Writ (Article 226) before High Court Green Bench.
overall_steps_en: Submit instant written complaint to BL&LRO, Local Police, and Fisheries Officer. | Authorities issue immediate Stop-Work Order under Section 17A Fisheries Act. | District Magistrate directs criminal prosecution and issues restoration notice. | If administration delays, move High Court Green Bench for excavation order.

title_en: Cancellation of Fraudulent Registered Sale Deed
relevant_act: Sec 31, Specific Relief Act, 1963 & Sec 82 Registration Act
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Senior / Junior Division) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified deed copy and thumb-impression audit from Registry Office. | File Civil Suit for Deed Cancellation under Section 31 Specific Relief Act. | Move Order XXXIX CPC application to restrain third-party sale of the land. | Court decrees cancellation and directs Sub-Registrar to endorse book records.

title_en: Tribal Land Transfer Restrictions (ST Land)
relevant_act: Chapter IIA (Sec 14B–14H), WBLR Act, 1955
overall_steps_en: Submit petition under Section 14C WBLR Act before Revenue Officer / DM. | Prove transfer lacked prior written statutory permission of District Magistrate. | Revenue Officer conducts hearing and issues physical eviction orders. | Land is re-entered in tribal owner’s name and handed over with police aid.

title_en: Distribution & Cancellation of Government Patta Land
relevant_act: Sec 49, West Bengal Land Reforms Act, 1955
authority_forum_en: Sub-Divisional Land and Land Reforms Officer (SD&LRO)
overall_steps_en: Submit application under Section 49(2) before the SD&LRO. | Prove patta holder was not a landless farmer or sold the land unlawfully. | SD&LRO holds field hearing and passes formal order annulling the patta. | Land is re-vested in State Khas Khatian and re-allotted to eligible BPL families.

title_en: Specific Performance of Land Sale Agreement (Baina)
relevant_act: Sec 10, 16 & 20, Specific Relief Act, 1963
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Senior / Junior Division) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Serve statutory legal notice expressing readiness to pay balance consideration. | File Civil Suit for Specific Performance under Section 10 of SRA within 3 years. | Deposit the balance sale consideration into court to prove continuous readiness. | Court passes decree; if seller refuses, court officer executes registered deed.

title_en: Land Acquisition Compensation Enhancement
relevant_act: Sec 64, RFCTLARR Act, 2013
timeframe_en: Within 6 weeks of award notice; 6 months to 1 year
overall_steps_en: Accept government compensation award strictly "Under Protest" in writing. | Submit Section 64 Reference Petition before the Collector within 6 weeks. | Collector forwards docket to the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation Authority (LARR). | Judge determines revised market value with 100% Solatium and 12% annual interest.

title_en: Undivided Share (UDS) Mutation for Flats
relevant_act: Sec 50 WBLR Act (Districts) / Sec 183 KMC Act (Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: BL&LRO (Banglarbhumi UDS Section) / BMC / HMC
rural_steps_en: Submit online Flat Mutation application on Banglarbhumi selecting UDS mode. | Upload registered flat conveyance deed mentioning exact square-foot UDS share. | Pay mutation fee via GRIPS and upload sanctioned building completion plan. | Download independent Khatian Porcha generated in flat owner’s name.
kolkata_authority_en: Kolkata Municipal Corporation (Assessment & Collection Dept)
kolkata_steps_en: Apply online on KMC portal for allotment of separate Assessee Number for flat unit. | Upload registered flat deed mentioning flat number, floor, and proportionate share. | KMC inspector inspects building and calculates individual flat annual property tax valuation. | Receive dedicated KMC Assessee Card and independent property tax billing status.
overall_steps_en: Submit online Flat Mutation application on Banglarbhumi selecting UDS mode. | Upload registered flat conveyance deed mentioning exact square-foot UDS share. | Pay mutation fee via GRIPS and upload sanctioned building completion plan. | Download independent Khatian Porcha generated in flat owner’s name.

title_en: Adverse Possession & Title by Prescription
relevant_act: Sec 27, Limitation Act, 1963; Ravinder Kaur Grewal (SC)
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Senior Division) / City Civil Court Kolkata
overall_steps_en: Compile 12+ years of continuous electricity, municipal tax, and voter proofs. | Serve formal legal reply refuting paper owner demands upon threatened eviction. | File Title Declaration Suit under Section 34 Specific Relief Act before Civil Judge. | Pray for Advocate Commissioner under Order XXVI CPC to verify physical boundary.

title_en: Encroachment on Common Village Land & Waterways
relevant_act: WBLR Act r/w Jagpal Singh v. State of Punjab (SC)
authority_forum_en: BL&LRO / Block Development Officer (BDO) / High Court
overall_steps_en: Submit joint citizen complaint to BL&LRO with photographic proof of encroachment. | Submit representation to DM citing Jagpal Singh Supreme Court directions. | Revenue Officer issues statutory eviction notice under Public Land Eviction Act. | If delayed, file Public Interest Litigation (PIL) before High Court at Calcutta.

title_en: Easementary Right of Way & Air/Light Protection
relevant_act: Sec 15 & 18, Indian Easements Act, 1882 & Sec 38 SRA
authority_forum_en: Civil Court / City Civil Court at Calcutta
timeframe_en: 20 years user; 6 months to 1 year suit
overall_steps_en: Serve statutory Cease and Desist Legal Notice to neighbor blocking the path. | File Civil Suit for Declaration of Easementary Right under Order VII CPC. | Move Order XXXIX CPC application to immediately halt construction on path. | Secure local inspection by court commissioner to record passage width.

title_en: Rectification of Clerical Errors in Registered Sale Deeds
relevant_act: Sec 26, Specific Relief Act, 1963 & Registration Act
overall_steps_en: Draft bilateral Deed of Rectification (Amolnama) with original vendor. | Pay nominal stamp duty and register at jurisdictional Sub-Registrar (ADSR). | If vendor refuses, file Civil Suit under Section 26 Specific Relief Act. | Submit rectified registered deed to BL&LRO to correct Banglarbhumi ROR.

title_en: Cancellation of Misused Power of Attorney / GPA Land Sale
relevant_act: Suraj Lamp (SC) r/w Powers of Attorney Act, 1882
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Senior Division) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Publish formal public notice of POA revocation and register Deed of Revocation. | Obtain certified copies of the fraudulent conveyance deed from ADSR. | File Suit for Cancellation of Deed under Section 31 Specific Relief Act. | Lodge criminal FIR under Section 316 BNS for criminal breach of trust.

title_en: De Facto Land Taking by Govt without Compensation
relevant_act: Art 300A, Constitution r/w Vidya Devi (SC)
overall_steps_en: Collect historical Porchas proving uninterrupted private ownership of road plot. | Submit representation to District Magistrate demanding formal notification/award. | Obtain BL&LRO Land Status Report verifying land was never formally acquired. | File Writ Petition (Mandamus) under Article 226 before High Court at Calcutta.

title_en: Declaration of Title & Recovery of Possession
relevant_act: Sec 5 & 34, Specific Relief Act, 1963
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Junior / Senior Division) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Trace title through 30-year chain deeds, Khajna receipts, and mutation records. | Serve statutory legal notice demanding peaceful handover of vacant possession. | File Civil Suit for Declaration of Title, Recovery of Possession, and Mesne Profits. | Execute final eviction decree with police assistance under Order XXI Rule 35 CPC.

title_en: Benami Property Attachment & Citizen Defense
relevant_act: Prohibition of Benami Property Transactions Act, 1988
overall_steps_en: Receive show-cause notice under Section 24(1) from the Initiating Officer. | Prepare factual reply proving purchase funds originated from declared family income. | Submit proof of Section 2(9)(A) statutory exemption (property held for spouse/child). | File appeal before the Appellate Tribunal against unlawful provisional attachment.

title_en: Revenue Map Discrepancy & Bhu-Naksha Mismatch
relevant_act: WBLR Manual (Districts) / KMC Smart Survey & Alignment (Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: BL&LRO (Technical Cartography Wing) / DL&LRO
rural_steps_en: Apply for certified copy of Mouza cadastral sheet from DL&LRO repository. | Submit petition for Map Rectification under Rule 48 before the BL&LRO. | Deposit government survey fee via GRIPS treasury challan. | Attend on-site survey conducted with Total Station Machine (TSM).
kolkata_authority_en: KMC Survey & Valuation Department
kolkata_steps_en: Apply for certified Street Alignment & Road Width Certificate from KMC Survey Dept. | Submit registered deed and historical municipal assessment maps to Chief Valuer. | KMC surveyor inspects property boundary to verify road widening encroachments. | Receive corrected municipal premises boundary alignment endorsement.
overall_steps_en: Apply for certified copy of Mouza cadastral sheet from DL&LRO repository. | Submit petition for Map Rectification under Rule 48 before the BL&LRO. | Deposit government survey fee via GRIPS treasury challan. | Attend on-site survey conducted with Total Station Machine (TSM).

title_en: Unauthorized Construction Demolition (Sec 4D WBLR vs Sec 400 KMC)
relevant_act: Sec 4D WBLR Act (Districts) / Sec 400 KMC Act (Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: District Land & Land Reforms Officer (DL&LRO / DM)
rural_steps_en: Extract Banglarbhumi land record proving plot is unconverted agricultural (Sali) land. | File official complaint before DL&LRO citing violation under Section 4D WBLR Act. | Revenue Officer issues statutory Stop-Work Order and summons violator for hearing. | DM orders physical demolition and restoration of agricultural classification.
kolkata_authority_en: KMC Special Officer (Building) / Municipal Building Tribunal (MBT)
kolkata_steps_en: Report unauthorized construction to KMC Borough Executive Engineer (Building). | KMC serves Stop-Work Notice under Section 401 and posts police guard. | Case heard by Special Officer (Building) under Section 400(1) for demolition order. | Appeal lies within 30 days before Municipal Building Tribunal (MBT) at Kolkata.
overall_steps_en: Extract Banglarbhumi land record proving plot is unconverted agricultural land. | File official complaint before the DL&LRO citing violation under Section 4D. | Revenue Officer issues statutory Stop-Work Order and summons the violator. | DM orders demolition and restoration of agricultural classification if unregularized.

title_en: Boundary Wall Erection Injunction & Neighbor Nuisance
relevant_act: Order XXXIX Rules 1 & 2 CPC r/w Sec 152 BNSS, 2023
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Junior Division) / City Civil Court Kolkata
overall_steps_en: Lodge a General Diary (GD) entry at the local police station regarding physical obstruction. | File petition under Section 163 BNSS before Executive Magistrate to prevent breach of peace. | Institute a Title Suit with an urgent ex-parte ad-interim injunction petition (Order XXXIX CPC). | Pray for police assistance under Section 151 CPC to deploy officers during boundary wall construction.

title_en: Agricultural Land Ceiling Exemption & Surplus Land Disputes
relevant_act: Chapter II-B, West Bengal Land Reforms Act, 1955
authority_forum_en: West Bengal Land Reforms Tenancy Tribunal (WBLRTT)
overall_steps_en: Collate Warishan family tree proving adult members lived as separate family units on appointed date. | File statutory objection under Section 14T before Revenue Officer challenging surplus calculation. | Challenge adverse vesting orders by filing Original Application (OA) before WBLRTT at Salt Lake. | Secure stay on physical dispossession or redistribution to third-party Patta holders.

title_en: Waqf Land Encroachment & Dedicated Estate Protection
relevant_act: Sec 54, 83 & 85, Waqf Act, 1995 (Amended)
overall_steps_en: Mutawalli submits application to CEO, Board of Waqfs, WB with property enrollment details. | CEO conducts inquiry and serves statutory eviction notice under Section 54(1) of Waqf Act. | If encroacher defaults, CEO files application before Waqf Tribunal for an eviction order. | Order transmitted to Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) to execute physical removal with police aid.

title_en: Sale of Mortgaged Land Without Bank Disclosure
relevant_act: Sec 55, TP Act, 1882 r/w Sec 318 BNS, 2023
timeframe_en: Immediate FIR; 1 to 2 years civil suit
overall_steps_en: Obtain Non-Encumbrance Certificate (NEC) confirming pre-existing bank mortgage charge. | Serve immediate legal notice for deed rescission and demand full refund plus interest. | File criminal FIR under Section 318(4) BNS for cheating at local Cyber/EOW cell. | Institute Money Suit with attachment-before-judgment application (Order XXXVIII CPC).

title_en: Lis Pendens Invalidation of Third-Party Land Deals
relevant_act: Sec 52, Transfer of Property Act, 1882
authority_forum_en: Civil Trial Court / City Civil Court at Calcutta
timeframe_en: During trial until final decree execution
overall_steps_en: Confirm original Title/Partition Suit was actively pending when third-party transfer occurred. | Move Order I Rule 10 CPC application to implead new purchaser as co-defendant. | File petition under Section 52 TP Act declaring transfer subservient to court decree. | Secure explicit injunction restraining new buyer from raising construction or changing land nature.

title_en: Writ of Mandamus Against Revenue Officer Inaction
relevant_act: Article 226, Constitution of India
overall_steps_en: Extract application receipts demonstrating pendency beyond 45 days. | Send formal Demand for Justice notice through High Court advocate giving 15-day window. | File Writ Petition in Nature of Mandamus (WPA) before High Court Single Bench. | High Court directs authority to hold hearing and pass reasoned order within 6 weeks.

title_en: Restoration of Dispossessed Agricultural Tenant / Ryot
relevant_act: Sec 49A & 50, WBLR Act r/w Tenancy Regulations
authority_forum_en: Revenue Officer / Sub-Divisional Land Reforms Officer
timeframe_en: Within 3 years of dispossession; 45 days hearing
overall_steps_en: File restoration application before Revenue Officer under Section 49A WBLR Act. | Attach rent receipts, crop sale vouchers, or historical Porcha proving cultivation. | Revenue Officer serves notice on dispossessor and conducts spot field inquiry. | Executive order directs local police to escort farmer back onto holding.

title_en: Forest Dwellers & Scheduled Tribes Land Claims (FRA)
relevant_act: Forest Rights Act, 2006 (FRA)
authority_forum_en: Gram Sabha -> SDLC -> District Level Committee (DLC)
overall_steps_en: Pass formal resolution before Gram Sabha verifying continuous ancestral cultivation. | Submit Form-A with elder witness statements and physical occupation markers. | Sub-Divisional Level Committee (SDLC) inspects boundaries and forwards report. | District Level Committee (DLC) chaired by DM issues statutory Forest Land Title.

title_en: De-freezing & Release of Land Attached in Criminal Trials
relevant_act: Sec 107 & Sec 88, BNSS, 2023
authority_forum_en: Court of Sessions / Special Designated Court
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copies of criminal attachment order issued by Special Judge. | File Objection Petition under Section 107(3) BNSS proving bona fide separate title. | Produce bank statements, purchase sources, and deeds proving innocence. | Obtain judicial de-attachment order and submit to ADSR and BL&LRO to clear records.

title_en: Allotment of Vested Surplus Land to Landless Laborers
relevant_act: Sec 49(1), West Bengal Land Reforms Act, 1955
overall_steps_en: Verify family eligibility: must be agricultural laborer owning under 1 acre. | Submit Form 12 before BL&LRO with BPL card, Aadhaar, and Panchayat residency. | Block Land Reforms Committee conducts public inquiry and prepares roster. | Issue heritable, non-transferable Patta signed by Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO).

title_en: Tree Cutting & Timber Rights on Boundary / Joint Land
relevant_act: WB Trees (Protection & Conservation) Act, 2006 (Districts) / KMC Parks (Kolkata)
overall_steps_en: Apply for tree-felling permit before Range Officer/DFO with replanting pledge. | If co-sharer cuts timber secretly, lodge immediate objection with Range Officer. | File Civil Suit for Injunction under Order XXXIX CPC to halt felling. | If already sold, pray for taking accounts and deposit of your share in court.

title_en: Bhoodan Land Grant Alienation Challenge
relevant_act: State Bhoodan Yagna Regulations r/w WBLR Act
authority_forum_en: SDO Revenue Court / District Land & Land Reforms Officer
overall_steps_en: Obtain historical Bhoodan Yagna Samiti allotment registers and early records. | Submit official representation to SDO highlighting unauthorized private sale. | Revenue Officer conducts inquiry and serves notice on unauthorized purchaser. | Cancel fraudulent mutation entries and re-allot holding to landless families.

title_en: Consolidation of Fragmented Holdings (Chakbandi)
relevant_act: WBLR Act (Chakbandi Provisions) & Bengal Survey Act
overall_steps_en: Form an association of contiguous plot holders and submit joint Chakbandi Petition. | Consolidation Officer prepares valuation map equalizing different soil qualities. | Draft preliminary consolidation scheme and publish for 30 days for objections. | Issue revised Consolidated Khatian certificates and update Banglarbhumi maps.

title_en: Police Protection Against Armed Land Grabbers
relevant_act: Sec 151 CPC r/w Sec 168 BNSS, 2023
overall_steps_en: Obtain ad-interim injunction order under Order XXXIX CPC prohibiting trespass. | File urgent application under Section 151 CPC for police deployment due to violations. | If local police station fails to deploy, file Writ Petition (Art 226) before High Court. | High Court directs Superintendent of Police (SP) or Police Commissioner to ensure 24/7 boundary protection.

title_en: Digitization Data Errors & Corrupted Record Recovery
relevant_act: Information Technology Act r/w WBLR Act / KMC IT Cell
authority_forum_en: DL&LRO IT Cell (Districts) / KMC IT Cell (Kolkata)
overall_steps_en: Locate physical legacy records: RS/LR Porchas, volume ledgers, and Khajna / KMC tax tokens. | File an administrative petition for Data Restoration before IT Nodal Officer. | Departmental data manager retrieves physical register volumes and executes verification. | Authorized database update by Revenue Officer / KMC with system audit logging.

title_en: Challenge to Highway Land Acquisition Compensation
relevant_act: Sec 3G(5), National Highways Act, 1956
authority_forum_en: Central Government Arbitrator (District Magistrate) / Commercial Court
overall_steps_en: Receive CALA compensation award notice under Section 3G(1) National Highways Act. | Collect certified sale deeds of high-value commercial land in immediate vicinity. | File Arbitration Petition under Section 3G(5) before Arbitrator (District Magistrate). | If award is inadequate, challenge arbitral award under Section 34 Arbitration Act.

title_en: Riverbed Siltation & Illegal Sand Mining Farmland Erosion
relevant_act: Mines & Minerals Act, 1957 & State Minor Mineral Rules
authority_forum_en: District Magistrate / National Green Tribunal (NGT Eastern Bench)
overall_steps_en: Record geotagged photographs of mechanized excavators mining outside lease boundaries. | Submit emergency complaint to District Mining Officer and Superintendent of Police. | File Original Application (OA) before National Green Tribunal (Eastern Zone Bench). | NGT halts mining, directs joint inspection, and levies environmental compensation.

title_en: Eviction of Encroachers from Railway Siding Commercial Zones
relevant_act: Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorised Occupants) Act, 1971
overall_steps_en: Receive show-cause notice under Section 4(1) of PPE Act from Estate Officer. | File written reply asserting valid lease renewal or rehabilitation entitlement. | Cross-examine authority surveyor regarding exact boundary right-of-way. | If eviction order passes, file Statutory Appeal under Section 9 before District Judge.

title_en: Ground Water Extraction & Farm Borewell Permissions
relevant_act: WB Ground Water Resources (Management, Control & Reg) Act, 2005
overall_steps_en: Submit Form-1 application for borewell sinking permit to District Authority (SWID). | Attach land deeds, Mouza map, and distance certificates from neighboring wells. | Technical site inspection by Geologist to assess local groundwater extraction. | Issuance of registration certificate and permit specifying allowed extraction depth.

title_en: Forged Patwari/Amin Revenue Endorsements
relevant_act: Sec 51A(4), WBLR Act r/w Sec 336 BNS, 2023
overall_steps_en: Apply for certified copies of original field notebook, Jamabandi, and mutation docket. | File formal complaint detailing forgery before Additional District Magistrate (DL&LRO). | DL&LRO initiates summary correction proceedings under Section 51A(4) WBLR Act. | Erroneous digital entries purged, historical title restored, and inquiry ordered.

title_en: Separation of Joint Khasra/Chittas & Demarcation
relevant_act: Order XXVI CPC r/w West Bengal Land Reforms Manual
overall_steps_en: File joint demarcation petition signed by co-sharers before BL&LRO. | Pay statutory survey fee via GRIPS challan and secure official date. | Revenue Amin visits plot with Total Station and drives concrete boundary pillars. | BL&LRO survey division updates Mouza map with new sub-plot (Bata) numbers.

title_en: Easement of Necessity for Landlocked Plots
relevant_act: Sec 13, Indian Easements Act, 1882
overall_steps_en: Produce original parent partition deed showing disputed land was severed from common holding. | File Civil Suit for Declaration of Easement of Necessity under Section 13. | Move application for Advocate Commissioner to verify that no alternative access exists. | Court decrees minimum motorable pathway (8 to 12 feet) over surrounding land.

title_en: Restoration of Alienated Scheduled Caste Land
relevant_act: State Agrarian Welfare Regulations r/w Article 15(4)
overall_steps_en: File restoration petition before Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO). | Submit proof that transferor belongs to Scheduled Caste community and lacked DM nod. | SDO summons buyer and conducts summary inquiry into consideration adequacy. | SDO annuls sale deed, cancels mutation, and restores physical possession.

title_en: Suit for Mesne Profits from Illegal Cultivation
relevant_act: Sec 2(12) & Order XX Rule 12, CPC, 1908
overall_steps_en: Obtain preliminary decree declaring lawful ownership and wrongful dispossession. | File application under Order XX Rule 12 CPC praying for inquiry into mesne profits. | Produce local mandi crop yield receipts and agricultural market prices for disputed years. | Court passes final decree directing trespasser to pay assessed sum plus 6% annual interest.

title_en: Solar & Wind Power Project Land Lease Disputes
relevant_act: Indian Contract Act, 1872 & Transfer of Property Act
overall_steps_en: Issue formal 30-day default notice citing unpaid monthly lease rent and escalation. | If solar firm defaults, file Commercial Suit under Commercial Courts Act, 2015. | Pray for attachment of revenue generated from grid electricity feed to discoms (WBSEDCL). | Obtain eviction order, compensation decree, and unencumbered land restoration.

title_en: Deposit of Rent with Rent Controller (Districts SDO vs Kolkata)
relevant_act: Sec 21 & 22, West Bengal Premises Tenancy (WBPT) Act, 1997
authority_forum_en: SDO Rent Controller (Districts) / Rent Controller Kolkata
timeframe_en: Within 21 days of postal money order refusal
rural_authority_en: Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) - District Rent Controller
rural_steps_en: Send monthly rent to landlord via Postal Money Order (POM) with coupon acknowledging tenancy. | Preserve postal refusal endorsement slip signed by postal delivery agent. | File Section 21 application before Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) acting as Rent Controller in 21 days. | Deposit rent in local State Treasury via GRIPS challan and collect verified receipt foil.
kolkata_authority_en: Office of the Rent Controller, Kolkata (2 & 3 Kiran Shankar Roy Road)
kolkata_steps_en: Send rent to landlord via registered POM with coupon mentioning Kolkata tenancy address. | Obtain postal refusal memo from India Post delivery branch in Kolkata. | File Section 21 Petition before Rent Controller, Kolkata (Kiran Shankar Roy Road) in 21 days. | Deposit monthly rent on Treasury Challan at Reserve Bank / State Treasury counter.
overall_steps_en: Send monthly rent via Postal Money Order (POM) with coupon acknowledging tenancy. | Retain postman refusal endorsement or postal tracking slip as legal evidence. | File application under Section 21 WBPT Act before Rent Controller within 21 days. | Deposit monthly rent on Treasury Challan and obtain official verified receipt foil.

title_en: Tenancy Eviction Suit on Statutory Grounds
relevant_act: Sec 6, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Districts) / Presidency Small Causes Court (Kolkata)
timeframe_en: 1-month Notice to Quit; 1 to 3 years trial
rural_authority_en: Court of Civil Judge (Junior / Senior Division) in District Courts
rural_steps_en: Serve statutory 1-month Notice to Quit under Section 6(4) via registered post with AD. | Wait for expiry of 30-day statutory notice cure window. | File Title Eviction Suit before jurisdictional Civil Judge in District Court (Alipore, Barasat, etc.). | Prove statutory ground, obtain eviction decree, and execute with district police assistance.
kolkata_authority_en: Presidency Small Causes Court / City Civil Court at Calcutta
kolkata_steps_en: Serve statutory 1-month Notice to Quit under Section 6(4) at Kolkata tenancy address. | Wait for expiry of 30-day notice period without tenant vacating premises. | File Ejectment Suit before Presidency Small Causes Court (up to pecuniary limit) or City Civil Court. | Secure ejectment decree; execute through Small Causes Court Bailiff.
overall_steps_en: Serve statutory 1-month Notice to Quit under Section 6(4) via registered post with AD. | Wait for expiry of the 30-day statutory notice cure window. | File Title Eviction Suit before the Civil Judge or Presidency Small Causes Court. | Prove statutory eviction ground, obtain eviction decree, and execute with police aid.

title_en: Emergency Restoration of Cut-off Water/Power
relevant_act: Sec 27, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
authority_forum_en: SDO Rent Controller (Districts) / Kolkata Rent Controller
timeframe_en: Interim restoration order within 24 to 48 hours
rural_authority_en: Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) / WBSEDCL Station Manager
rural_steps_en: File emergency Section 27 petition before SDO Rent Controller with recent rent receipts. | SDO issues show-cause notice to landlord returnable within 24 hours. | If landlord fails to restore, SDO orders WBSEDCL/Panchayat to reconnect line under police escort. | Landlord penalized with statutory fine up to double the restoration cost.
kolkata_authority_en: Rent Controller, Kolkata / CESC Special Grievance Cell
kolkata_steps_en: File urgent Section 27 petition before Rent Controller Kolkata at Kiran Shankar Roy Road. | Produce Rent Controller deposit challans and proof of sudden power/water disconnection. | Rent Controller issues interim order within 24 hours directed to CESC / KMC Water Dept. | CESC technical team reconnects power under order of the Rent Controller.
overall_steps_en: File an emergency petition under Section 27 WBPT Act before the Rent Controller. | Produce recent rent receipts and proof that essential services were severed without court order. | Rent Controller issues immediate ex-parte notice ordering restoration within 24 hours. | If landlord defaults, Rent Controller authorizes utility to reconnect with police assistance.

title_en: Fixation & Revision of Fair/Standard Rent
relevant_act: Sec 17 & 18, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
rural_authority_en: Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) Rent Controller
rural_steps_en: File Section 17 fair rent application before SDO Rent Controller with tenancy agreement. | SDO calls for building valuation report from Assistant Engineer (PWD Roads/Construction). | Calculate standard rent based on market cost of construction plus land value percentage. | SDO passes final order fixing fair rent binding on landlord and tenant.
kolkata_authority_en: Office of the Rent Controller, Kolkata
kolkata_steps_en: Submit Section 17 petition before Rent Controller Kolkata with KMC tax assessment bill. | Rent Controller deputes building inspector to verify floor area, lift, and common amenities. | Apply statutory formula linking KMC Annual Valuation to fair rental return. | Rent Controller passes formal decree fixing standard monthly rent.
overall_steps_en: File an application under Section 17 before the Rent Controller for fair rent fixation. | Submit certified copies of municipal property tax valuation and current rent receipts. | Rent Controller appoints an inspector to survey premise area and amenities. | Pass final reasoned order fixing statutory standard rent binding on both parties.

title_en: Essential Structural Repairs & Rent Deduction
relevant_act: Sec 24 & 25, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
timeframe_en: 30 working days notice; capped at half yearly rent
overall_steps_en: Serve a registered written notice under Section 24 requesting landlord to repair within 30 days. | If landlord fails to act, prepare an itemized cost estimate by a licensed civil contractor. | File an application under Section 25 before Rent Controller seeking permission to repair. | Carry out repairs and deduct validated costs from monthly rent (up to statutory ceiling).

title_en: Commercial vs Residential Exemption Ceilings
relevant_act: Sec 3(a) & 3(b), West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Transfer of Property Act Jurisdiction)
rural_authority_en: Court of Civil Judge (Senior Division) in Districts
rural_steps_en: Verify monthly rent exceeds district threshold: Residential > ₹3,000/mo or Commercial > ₹5,000/mo. | Confirm premises is exempt from WBPT Act rent controller protection. | Serve 15-day Notice to Terminate Tenancy under Section 106 Transfer of Property Act. | File civil ejectment suit in District Court; tenant cannot claim statutory rent control defense.
kolkata_authority_en: City Civil Court at Calcutta / High Court Original Side
kolkata_steps_en: Verify monthly rent exceeds Kolkata threshold: Residential > ₹6,500/mo or Commercial > ₹10,000/mo. | Confirm tenancy falls under Transfer of Property Act rather than WBPT Act. | Serve statutory 15-day termination notice under Section 106 TP Act. | File suit for ejectment and mesne profits before City Civil Court or High Court Original Side.
overall_steps_en: Verify rent threshold: Kolkata municipal limits vs other district thresholds. | If above ceiling, confirm tenancy is exempt from WBPT Act and governed by Transfer of Property Act. | Landlord serves 15-day Notice to Terminate Tenancy under Section 106 TP Act. | File suit for ejectment and mesne profits before the Civil Court directly.

title_en: Sub-letting without Landlord Consent Eviction
relevant_act: Sec 6(1)(a) & Sec 26, WBPT Act, 1997
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Districts) / Presidency Small Causes Court (Kolkata)
overall_steps_en: Collect evidence of unauthorized third-party commercial or residential occupancy. | Verify that no statutory notice of subletting under Section 26 was served by tenant. | Serve a 1-month Notice to Quit under Section 6(1)(a) citing illegal subletting. | File an eviction suit impleading both chief tenant and sub-tenant to obtain vacant possession.

title_en: Succession of Tenancy Rights & 5-Year Expiry
relevant_act: Sec 2(g), West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Junior Division) / Presidency Small Causes Court
overall_steps_en: Calculate exact 5-year timeline from death of original recorded tenant. | Verify surviving heirs do not qualify as fully dependent (e.g. they own alternate homes). | Serve Notice to Quit upon expiry of statutory 5-year period under Section 2(g). | File eviction suit on grounds that tenancy rights have legally extinguished by operation of law.

title_en: Immediate Recovery for Senior Citizens & Armed Forces
relevant_act: Sec 10, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
authority_forum_en: Rent Controller (SDO in Districts / Kolkata Bench)
overall_steps_en: Verify applicant eligibility: Senior citizen (age 65+), Armed Forces retiree, or widow. | File summary application under Section 10 before Rent Controller with age/pension proof. | Tenant must obtain special leave to contest within 30 days by showing genuine grounds. | If leave is refused or disproved, Rent Controller orders immediate summary eviction within 60 days.

title_en: Unlawful Dispossession / Lock-out of Tenant
relevant_act: Sec 6, Specific Relief Act, 1963 & Sec 163 BNSS
authority_forum_en: Civil Court / Executive Magistrate / City Civil Court
timeframe_en: Within 6 months of lockout; Urgent interim in 7 days
overall_steps_en: Call Police Helpline (112) immediately and record General Diary (GD) of illegal lock-out. | File emergency petition under Section 163 BNSS before Executive Magistrate to record possession. | Institute Summary Suit under Section 6 Specific Relief Act within 6 months of dispossession. | Court restores physical possession irrespective of title disputes between parties.

title_en: Execution of Eviction Decree & Police Assistance
relevant_act: Order XXI Rules 35 & 36 r/w Sec 151 CPC
authority_forum_en: Civil Executing Court (District Courts / Small Causes Court)
overall_steps_en: File Execution Petition under Order XXI Rule 11 CPC along with certified eviction decree. | Court issues Writ of Delivery of Possession (Warrant of Possession) to Civil Court Bailiff. | If tenant physically resists, file application under Section 151 CPC for police deployment. | Executing court issues police assistance order; bailiff breaks locks and hands over vacant keys.

title_en: Refund of Security Deposit / Advance Rent
relevant_act: Sec 5 & 7, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
authority_forum_en: Rent Controller / Presidency Small Causes Court
overall_steps_en: Document peaceful key handover via registered delivery or signed receipt voucher. | Serve formal legal notice demanding return of deposit within 15 days with interest. | File application under Section 5 WBPT Act before Rent Controller for penal refund. | Rent Controller summons landlord, imposes penalties, and issues recovery certificate.

title_en: Eviction of Licensee upon Revocation of License
relevant_act: Sec 60, Indian Easements Act, 1882
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Junior / Senior Division) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Verify license terms and confirm agreement creates no legal tenancy rights. | Serve formal Notice of Revocation of License giving 15 days to vacate premises. | File Civil Suit for Mandatory Injunction directing licensee to quit and vacate. | Secure decree for physical handover; claim occupational damages for overstay period.

title_en: Dangerous Insecure Building Notice & Rehabilitation
relevant_act: Sec 411, KMC Act, 1980 (Kolkata) / WB Municipal Act (Districts)
rural_authority_en: District Municipality / Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM)
rural_steps_en: Inspect municipal dangerous building notice issued under West Bengal Municipal Act. | Engage chartered engineer to verify whether building can be secured by structural retrofitting. | Execute written rehabilitation settlement before Municipal Chairman ensuring commercial/living space. | If landlord attempts eviction without rehabilitation, move Civil Judge for stay.
kolkata_authority_en: Municipal Building Tribunal (MBT) / KMC Building Department
kolkata_steps_en: Receive Section 411 notice from KMC Borough Executive Engineer (Building). | Execute tripartite agreement ensuring registered tenancy rehabilitation under KMC rules. | If notice is used by promoter to fraudulently oust tenants, file appeal before Municipal Building Tribunal. | Move High Court under Article 226 securing conditional municipal sanction protecting re-entry.
overall_steps_en: Inspect municipal Section 411 notice to determine whether building requires repair or demolition. | Execute tri-partite Development Agreement ensuring guaranteed re-allotment of equivalent space. | If landlord uses demolition to extinguish tenancies, file appeal before Building Tribunal. | Move High Court under Article 226 securing conditional municipal sanction protecting re-entry.

title_en: Thika Tenant vs Bharatia (Sub-tenant) Dispute
relevant_act: Sec 7 & 8, West Bengal Thika Tenancy Act, 2001
authority_forum_en: Office of the Thika Controller (Kolkata / Howrah)
overall_steps_en: Establish status: Thika tenant holds land rights from State; Bharatia holds structure tenancy. | Bharatia deposits rent with Thika Controller under Section 7 if Thika tenant refuses acceptance. | File application before Thika Controller for resolution of fair rent or essential repairs. | Thika Controller conducts hearing and issues binding order enforceable as a civil decree.

title_en: Model Tenancy Act & Digital Agreement Protocols
relevant_act: Model Tenancy Act Framework r/w Registration Act, 1908
timeframe_en: Mandatory registration within 60 days of execution
overall_steps_en: Draft a formal tenancy contract in statutory format specifying rent, deposit, and tenure. | Pay required stamp duty and execute agreement before a Notary or Sub-Registrar. | Submit digital copy to Rent Authority portal within 60 days to generate unique ID. | Retain statutory registration receipt; courts reject eviction claims on unregistered agreements.

title_en: Arbitrary & Unilateral Rent Escalation
relevant_act: Sec 17, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
overall_steps_en: Send written reply to escalation letter, tendering rent at existing statutory rate. | If landlord refuses payment, tender rent via Postal Money Order (POM) with coupon memo. | If POM is returned refused, file petition under Section 21 to deposit rent with Rent Controller. | Apply under Section 17 to formally fix standard rent and restrain arbitrary escalation.

title_en: Commercial Co-Working & Office Lock-in Disputes
relevant_act: Sec 73 & 74, Indian Contract Act, 1872
overall_steps_en: Review lease to determine whether lock-in clause acts as an unenforceable punitive penalty. | Serve formal termination notice citing fundamental frustration or economic force majeure. | File Pre-Institution Mediation petition under Section 12A Commercial Courts Act via DLSA. | If mediation fails, institute Commercial Summary Suit praying for release of unadjusted deposit.

title_en: Damages & Mesne Profits for Overstaying Tenant
relevant_act: Order XX Rule 12 CPC r/w Sec 108, TP Act
authority_forum_en: Civil Court / Presidency Small Causes Court
overall_steps_en: Serve statutory Notice to Quit under Section 106 TP Act terminating tenancy upon lease expiry. | Explicitly notify tenant in writing that continued stay will accrue damages at double market rate. | File Eviction Suit combined with application for mesne profits under Order XX Rule 12 CPC. | Obtain money decree for accrued damages and execute by attaching tenant bank accounts.

title_en: Landlord Intrusions & Tenant Privacy Violations
relevant_act: Sec 108(c), TP Act (Quiet Enjoyment) r/w Sec 329, BNS
overall_steps_en: Maintain written log and video recordings documenting unauthorized intrusions and harassment. | Issue legal notice asserting statutory covenant of "quiet enjoyment" under Section 108(c) TP Act. | Lodge police complaint under Section 329 BNS for criminal trespass if intrusion is repeated. | File suit for permanent injunction restraining landlord from entering without 24-hour written notice.

title_en: Recovery of Costs for Property Damage Caused by Tenant
relevant_act: Sec 108(m) & (o), Transfer of Property Act, 1882
overall_steps_en: Conduct exit inspection with tenant; prepare signed inventory of structural and fixture damages. | Engage licensed civil engineer to prepare an itemized assessment and repair cost bill. | Serve demand notice deducting assessed cost from deposit and demanding payment of balance. | File Money Suit in Small Causes Court to recover balance damages exceeding the deposit.

title_en: Eviction for Landlord's Bonafide Personal Use
relevant_act: Sec 6(1)(d), West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
overall_steps_en: Serve 1-month Notice to Quit under Section 6(1)(d) citing genuine personal necessity. | File Title Eviction Suit before jurisdictional Civil Judge upon notice expiry. | Produce municipal tax returns proving landlord owns no other vacant home in town. | Obtain eviction decree and apply for execution under Order XXI Rule 35 CPC.

title_en: Commercial Lease Force Majeure & Rent Abatement
relevant_act: Sec 56, Contract Act r/w Ramanand v. Dr. Girry Rathore
overall_steps_en: Examine commercial lease contract to determine whether Force Majeure covers government closures. | If clause is absent, invoke common law principles (*Ramanand* precedent) for rent postponement. | Initiate commercial conciliation before DLSA mediation to negotiate mutually agreed discount. | If landlord threatens lockout, move Commercial Court under Section 9 Arbitration Act for stay.

title_en: Unauthorized Commercial Use in Residential Tenancy
relevant_act: Sec 6(1)(h), WBPT Act, 1997 r/w Municipal Bye-laws
authority_forum_en: Civil Court / Municipal Building Department / KMC
overall_steps_en: Collect evidence of commercial misuse: commercial delivery logs, noise, and machinery photos. | Lodge complaint with municipal licensing department for running unlicensed trade in residential zone. | Serve a 30-day Notice to Quit under Section 6(1)(h) WBPT Act for unauthorized change of user. | File Title Eviction Suit and obtain interim injunction restraining commercial usage during trial.

title_en: Slum Tenant Rehabilitation & Demolition Rights
relevant_act: West Bengal Slum Areas (Improvement & Clearance) Act, 1972
authority_forum_en: Thika Controller / KMC Slum Clearance Cell / High Court
overall_steps_en: Compile proof of slum tenancy: municipal bustee census survey tokens and power bills. | File objection before Thika Controller against private builder attempting eviction without scheme. | Verify builder executed approved Rehabilitation Agreement offering transit rent and replacement flat. | If demolition is attempted by force, file emergency Writ Petition under Article 226 before High Court.

title_en: Sub-Tenant Protection in Collusive Tenancy Surrenders
relevant_act: Sec 26, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
authority_forum_en: Rent Controller Court (SDO in Districts / Kolkata Bench)
overall_steps_en: Produce written proof that subletting was with landlord consent or notified under Section 26. | Upon learning of collusive surrender, file petition before Rent Controller claiming direct tenancy. | Tender rent directly to the superior landlord; if refused, deposit under Section 21 WBPT Act. | Obtain injunction restraining landlord from taking physical possession without a civil decree.

title_en: Landlord Refusal to Issue Legal Rent Receipts
relevant_act: Sec 23, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
authority_forum_en: Rent Controller Court (SDO in Districts / Kolkata Bench)
overall_steps_en: Pay monthly rent exclusively via bank transfer (NEFT/UPI) or postal money order with clear memo. | Send registered demand letter requesting signed paper receipts for last 12 months under Section 23. | If landlord refuses, file application before Rent Controller praying for penal action and receipt issuance. | Rent Controller summons landlord, levies fine up to double the rent, and certifies payments on record.

title_en: Tenant Right of Pre-emption / First Refusal to Buy
relevant_act: Specific Relief Act, 1963 & Indian Contract Act, 1872
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Specific Performance Bench) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Verify rental contract contains an explicit Right of First Refusal (ROFR) or pre-emption clause. | Upon landlord intent to sell, request written disclosure of third-party offer and match it in 30 days. | If landlord secretly sells to an outsider, issue immediate legal notice asserting breach of contract. | File Civil Suit for Specific Performance, depositing matching purchase consideration into court.

title_en: Gated Society Maintenance Surcharges on Tenants
relevant_act: WB Apartment Ownership Act, 1972 r/w CPA, 2019
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copy of RWA by-laws and circulars mandating higher fees for tenants. | Issue legal notice asserting maintenance must match actual common expenses without discrimination. | File complaint before Competent Authority under West Bengal Apartment Ownership Act. | Move District Consumer Commission for refund of excess charges collected under threat of amenity cuts.

title_en: Tenant Making Structural Alterations Without Written NOC
relevant_act: Sec 6(1)(e) & 108(p) TP Act r/w WBPT Act
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Civil Judge Division) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Capture real-time photographic evidence of unauthorized wall demolition or construction. | Lodge immediate General Diary (GD) with local police station and alert municipal surveyor. | File Title Eviction Suit under Section 6(1)(e) WBPT Act with urgent ex-parte injunction petition. | Obtain mandatory injunction directing tenant to restore damaged structure at their personal cost.

title_en: Tenancy at Will vs Tenancy at Sufferance Liabilities
relevant_act: Sec 106 & 111, Transfer of Property Act, 1882
overall_steps_en: Determine whether tenant holds over with consent (Tenancy at Will) or without (Tenancy at Sufferance). | If rent was accepted post-expiry, serve statutory 15-day notice under Section 106 to terminate tenancy. | If rent was refused, institute suit for recovery of possession against Tenant at Sufferance as trespasser. | Claim full mesne profits and occupational charges assessed on prevailing commercial market rates.

title_en: Industrial Warehouse & Logistics Space Eviction
relevant_act: Commercial Courts Act, 2015 r/w Transfer of Property Act
overall_steps_en: Audit commercial lease agreement and quantify unpaid warehousing rent and CAM charges. | Complete pre-institution mediation under Section 12A Commercial Courts Act through DLSA. | File Commercial Eviction Suit praying for summary judgment under Order XIII-A CPC. | Move urgent application under Order XXXVIII Rule 5 CPC for attachment of stored warehouse inventory.

title_en: Eviction Defense for Schools, Hospitals & Charities
relevant_act: Sec 6, WBPT Act r/w Public Policy Exceptions
authority_forum_en: Civil Court / High Court at Calcutta
overall_steps_en: Reply to landlord notice highlighting premises house recognized education/health facilities. | Offer current fair commercial rent and request an extended timeline until academic session ends. | If landlord cuts utilities, apply to Rent Controller under Section 27 for immediate restoration. | File an application before Civil Judge praying for an equitable balance-of-convenience stay.

title_en: Expiry of 99-Year Leasehold Estate & Resumption
relevant_act: Transfer of Property Act r/w State Urban Land Allotment Policies
authority_forum_en: Urban Development Department / High Court (Appellate Side)
overall_steps_en: Review original 99-year lease grant for renewal clauses, covenants for automatic extension, or heir rights. | Submit application for Leasehold-to-Freehold Conversion under State Urban Development scheme. | Pay prescribed government conversion and development charges via treasury challan. | If government issues arbitrary resumption notice, file Writ Petition (Art 226) before High Court.

title_en: Tenant Installing Separate Electric Meter (CESC vs WBSEDCL)
relevant_act: Sec 43, Electricity Act, 2003 r/w WBERC Regulations
rural_authority_en: WBSEDCL Customer Care Center / Regional GRO
rural_steps_en: Apply online on WBSEDCL portal for domestic connection uploading rent receipts/tenancy agreement. | If WBSEDCL issues objection citing lack of landlord NOC, submit representation citing Section 43. | Lodge grievance before Regional Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum (CGRF). | If denied, file Writ Petition before High Court; Calcutta HC precedent confirms power is an Article 21 right.
kolkata_authority_en: CESC Limited (Kolkata & Howrah Commercial Cell)
kolkata_steps_en: Submit online new connection request on CESC portal with rent challan/receipt as occupancy proof. | CESC inspector inspects meter board room; if landlord obstructs, inspector lodges police diary. | File representation before Central Grievance Redressal Officer (CGRO) at Victoria House, Kolkata. | High Court at Calcutta issues police assistance order commanding CESC to energize meter.
overall_steps_en: Apply for new connection on utility portal (CESC/WBSEDCL) with rent receipts as proof. | If utility issues objection citing lack of Landlord NOC, submit representation citing Section 43. | File statutory grievance before Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum (CGRF) under Section 42(5). | If denied, file Writ Petition before High Court; Calcutta HC precedent confirms power is an Article 21 right.

title_en: Eviction Due to Public Nuisance & Immoral Activities
relevant_act: Sec 6(1)(b), WBPT Act, 1997 r/w Sec 292, BNS
overall_steps_en: Collect written complaints signed by neighbors, apartment RWA, and police intervention diaries. | Lodge petition under Section 152 BNSS before Executive Magistrate to record findings of public nuisance. | Serve statutory 1-month Notice to Quit under Section 6(1)(b) WBPT Act citing nuisance and misuse. | File Title Eviction Suit and obtain interim restraining order preventing antisocial activities pending trial.

title_en: Impounding of Unstamped / Under-Stamped Rental Deeds
relevant_act: Sec 33 & 35, Indian Stamp Act, 1899
authority_forum_en: Civil Court / Collector of Stamp Revenue
overall_steps_en: Civil court impounds the unstamped agreement under Section 33 when tendered in evidence. | File an application under Section 35 Indian Stamp Act praying for admissibility upon payment of penalty. | Court transmits instrument to Collector of Stamp Revenue to calculate deficit duty and 10x penalty. | Pay certified challan into government treasury; court marks rental agreement as admissible evidence.

title_en: Landlord Barring Lift, Common Passages & Rooftop
relevant_act: Sec 27, WBPT Act r/w Sec 152, BNSS
overall_steps_en: Take photographs and video evidence of locks and barriers blocking elevators or common passages. | File emergency application before Rent Controller under Section 27 for essential service restoration. | Rent Controller conducts summary hearing within 24 hours and issues direction to unblock access. | If landlord defaults, Rent Controller authorizes local police station to physically break padlocks.

title_en: Formal Landlord-Tenant Settlement & Exit Agreements
relevant_act: Sec 89, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 & Contract Act
authority_forum_en: DLSA Pre-Litigation Mediation Cell / Lok Adalat
overall_steps_en: Submit joint application for pre-litigation conciliation before District Legal Services Authority (DLSA). | Attend mediation sessions with trained conciliators to finalize exit dates, repairs, and accounts. | Execute formal Memorandum of Settlement (MoS) detailing key handover against deposit bank transfer. | Record settlement before National Lok Adalat; the award operates as a final, non-appealable civil decree.

title_en: Bogus Renovation Notice to Force Out Low-Rent Tenants
relevant_act: Sec 6(1)(f) & Sec 11, WBPT Act, 1997
rural_authority_en: SDO Rent Controller & Municipality / Panchayat
rural_steps_en: Reply to repair notice challenging that building is structurally sound without need for eviction. | Demand production of sanctioned reconstruction plan approved by District Municipality / Zilla Parishad. | File Section 11 petition before SDO Rent Controller asserting statutory right of re-entry. | Civil Judge restrains demolition until landlord furnishes bank security for tenant re-accommodation.
kolkata_authority_en: Rent Controller, Kolkata & KMC Building Department
kolkata_steps_en: Submit formal objection before Rent Controller Kolkata challenging bogus renovation claims. | Demand certified copy of KMC sanctioned reconstruction plan under KMC Building Rules. | Invoke Section 11 WBPT Act securing judicial direction for re-entry into reconstructed space. | Move City Civil Court / High Court restraining promoter from altering tenanted space boundary.
overall_steps_en: Reply to renovation notice challenging that building is not in a dangerous structural condition. | Demand production of sanctioned reconstruction building plan approved by municipal authorities. | File petition before Rent Controller under Section 11 demanding statutory right of re-entry post-repair. | Move Civil Judge for injunction restraining demolition until landlord deposits security for re-allotment.

title_en: Commercial Mall Kiosk & Retail Space Lock-out
relevant_act: Sec 9, Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1996 / Commercial Court
overall_steps_en: Verify dispute resolution clause in commercial lease agreement mandates arbitration. | File Section 9 petition before Commercial Court praying for urgent interim measures of protection. | Demonstrate irreparable business loss, loss of customer goodwill, and staff livelihood impact. | Obtain injunction directing mall management to restore power and access upon conditional fee deposit.

title_en: Public Premises Eviction (PPE) for Overstaying Quarters
relevant_act: Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorised Occupants) Act, 1971
overall_steps_en: Receive show-cause notice under Section 4(1) of PPE Act from the Estate Officer. | File written reply explaining retention permissions, medical treatments, or pending gratuity. | If eviction order is issued under Section 5, file immediate Statutory Appeal under Section 9 before District Judge. | Obtain stay on eviction and challenge calculation of penal market rent damages.

title_en: Eviction Defense in Heritage Protected Buildings
relevant_act: West Bengal Heritage Commission Act, 2001 r/w KMC Act
rural_authority_en: West Bengal Heritage Commission & District Magistrate
rural_steps_en: Verify historic building listing in state protected monuments register. | File written complaint with District Magistrate against unauthorized commercial demolition. | West Bengal Heritage Commission conducts architectural inspection of site. | District administration posts police guard halting structural changes.
kolkata_authority_en: KMC Heritage Conservation Committee & High Court
kolkata_steps_en: Check KMC Graded Heritage list (Grade-I, IIA, IIB) for disputed premises. | Lodge objection before KMC Heritage Conservation Committee against builder redevelopment. | Submit representation to Mayor-in-Council halting municipal sanction clearances. | Obtain High Court injunction restraining demolition without full Heritage Commission nod.
overall_steps_en: Check municipal heritage building schedule to confirm Grade-I or Grade-II status of premise. | File official objection before Heritage Conservation Committee against unapproved demolition. | Submit representation to West Bengal Heritage Commission to conduct architectural audit. | Obtain injunction from High Court at Calcutta restraining structural alterations and eviction.

title_en: Suing Landlord for Withheld Deposit with 18% Interest
relevant_act: Sec 5 & 7, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
overall_steps_en: Produce signed handover memorandum or postal tracking proof that vacant possession was delivered. | Serve statutory legal notice demanding immediate return of deposit with 18% interest in 15 days. | File Summary Suit under Order XXXVII CPC or complaint before District Consumer Commission. | Secure money decree directing refund with interest and attachment of rental premises upon default.

title_en: Landlord Liability for Tenant Injuries from Collapsing Ceilings
relevant_act: Sec 108(f), Transfer of Property Act r/w Law of Torts
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Senior Division) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Collate previous written letters and text messages warning landlord of ceiling cracks and plaster fall. | Preserve hospital emergency admission records, injury scan reports, and surgery bills. | File Civil Suit for Damages and Tortious Liability against landlord before Civil Judge. | Move for inquiry into building stability by municipal engineer to support personal injury claim.

title_en: Defense of Waiver: Landlord Accepting Rent Post-Notice
relevant_act: Sec 113, Transfer of Property Act, 1882
timeframe_en: Raised in Written Statement (Within 30 days of summons)
overall_steps_en: Verify bank statements proving landlord deposited and cleared rent dated after notice expired. | Draft Written Statement raising primary legal defense of "Waiver of Notice to Quit" under Section 113. | Frame preliminary issue of law under Order XIV Rule 2 CPC regarding maintainability of suit. | Secure dismissal of eviction suit on ground that acceptance of rent renewed ongoing tenancy.

title_en: Determination of Lease by Forfeiture
relevant_act: Sec 111(g), Transfer of Property Act, 1882
timeframe_en: 15-day cure notice window; 6 months to 1 year trial
overall_steps_en: Identify express condition breached in registered lease (e.g. non-payment for 3 consecutive months). | Serve statutory notice in writing under Section 111(g) specifying breach and giving 15-day cure window. | If tenant fails to remedy breach within 15 days, serve final notice determining lease by forfeiture. | File suit for ejectment and mesne profits before Civil Judge based on determination of tenancy.

title_en: Dispossession During Court Vacation & Emergency Injunction
relevant_act: Sec 151, CPC r/w High Court Vacation Rules
authority_forum_en: Vacation Civil Judge / High Court Vacation Bench
overall_steps_en: Collect real-time photographic proof of demolition threats, padlocks, or forcible dispossession. | Draft urgent Plaint and Injunction Application under Section 151 CPC addressed to Vacation Judge. | Serve notice on Vacation Officer / Registrar of Civil Court or High Court Appellate Side. | Secure emergency holiday injunction order directing local police station to maintain status quo.

title_en: Paying Guest (PG) & Student Hostel Arbitrary Eviction
relevant_act: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 & Specific Relief Act, 1963
timeframe_en: Immediate police intervention; 30 days consumer notice
overall_steps_en: Produce PG rent receipts, UPI payment records, and college identity cards proving occupancy. | Call 112 emergency line if PG owner attempts to lock rooms or throw belongings onto the street. | Lodge a formal police complaint citing criminal intimidation under Section 351 BNS. | File a complaint before District Consumer Commission for gross deficiency of service and fee forfeiture.

title_en: Landlord Obstructing Commercial Trade License Renewal
relevant_act: KMC Act, 1980 (Kolkata) / WB Municipal Act (Districts)
authority_forum_en: Municipal Licensing Dept (KMC / Municipality) / High Court
rural_authority_en: District Municipality / Gram Panchayat Licensing Wing
rural_steps_en: Produce certified SDO Rent Controller challans proving ongoing lawful commercial tenancy. | Submit Certificate of Enlistment renewal with affidavit of landlord non-cooperation. | Executive Officer issues trade license renewal without requiring landlord physical consent. | If denied, file representation citing High Court Division Bench precedents.
kolkata_authority_en: KMC License Department (Borough Office)
kolkata_steps_en: Collect up-to-date Rent Controller Kolkata challans and previous KMC CE certificate. | Apply online on KMC Trade Portal under "Tenant Mode" attaching non-cooperation affidavit. | KMC Licensing Officer conducts verification of shop establishment and generates demand fee. | Download permanent Certificate of Enlistment (CE) from KMC portal.
overall_steps_en: Collect certified copies of up-to-date Rent Controller challans proving ongoing lawful tenancy. | Submit renewal application to Municipal Borough Licensing Officer with non-cooperation affidavit. | If municipality refuses citing lack of landlord signature, issue legal notice citing High Court precedents. | If municipal department delays, file Writ Petition (Art 226) commanding issuance of certificate of enlistment.

title_en: Consumer Claims on e-Jagriti Portal (e-Daakhil)
relevant_act: Sec 35, Consumer Protection Act, 2019
overall_steps_en: Register on https://e-jagriti.gov.in/ with Aadhaar and mobile OTP verification. | Draft complaint petition detailing deficiency of service and quantified compensation. | Upload purchase invoice, warranty card, and opposite party communication logs. | Pay nominal online court fees via Bharatkosh; track digital hearing summons.

title_en: WBRERA Builder Delay, Interest & Refund (Form-M)
relevant_act: Sec 18, Real Estate (Regulation & Dev) Act, 2016
authority_forum_en: West Bengal Real Estate Regulatory Authority (WBRERA Bench)
overall_steps_en: Verify project RERA registration number and sanctioned possession completion date. | File online complaint in Form-M on the WBRERA portal paying statutory ₹1,000 fee. | Serve formal digital notice to developer detailing payment receipts and default days. | WBRERA Bench orders refund with SBI MCLR+2% interest or monthly delay payout.

title_en: Electricity Bills & Meter Disputes (WBSEDCL vs CESC)
relevant_act: Sec 42(5), Electricity Act, 2003 & WBERC Regs
authority_forum_en: CGRF GRO (WBSEDCL in Districts / CESC in Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: WBSEDCL Customer Care Center / Regional GRO (22 Districts)
rural_steps_en: Submit written objection to Station Manager at local WBSEDCL Customer Care Center (CCC). | If uncorrected in 15 days, appeal before Regional Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO). | Pay disputed amount under protest via GRIPS or WBSEDCL portal to prevent disconnection. | Escalate to Electricity Ombudsman (WBERC) for independent third-party meter calibration.
kolkata_authority_en: CESC Limited Commercial Cell / Central GRO (Victoria House)
kolkata_steps_en: Lodge billing dispute online via CESC portal or visit Regional Commercial Office. | Appeal to Central Grievance Redressal Officer (CGRO) at Victoria House, Kolkata. | CESC technical squad inspects digital meter and compares historical consumption data. | If aggrieved, move Ombudsman under WBERC for refund of inflated bill amounts.
overall_steps_en: Submit written objection to Station Manager / Local Customer Care Center. | File statutory appeal before Regional Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO). | Escalate unresolved dispute within 60 days to Electricity Ombudsman (Kolkata). | Secure order for third-party independent meter testing and tariff re-calculation.

title_en: Hospital Billing Fraud & Medical Negligence
relevant_act: WB Clinical Establishments Act, 2017 & CPA, 2019
authority_forum_en: West Bengal Clinical Establishments Regulatory Commission (WBCERC) / DCDRC
overall_steps_en: Demand itemized daily pharmacy sheets, doctor fee logs, and investigation vouchers. | File immediate petition before WBCERC (Kolkata) against dead body hold or package inflation. | Commission holds summary hearing and orders release of patient/body with interim deposit. | File DCDRC consumer complaint claiming compensation for gross medical negligence.

title_en: Apartment Owners Association Handover & Parking
relevant_act: WB Apartment Ownership Act, 1972 r/w WBRERA
rural_authority_en: Competent Authority (District Housing Cell) / BMC / HMC
rural_steps_en: Convene general body meeting of allottees adopting statutory Form-A bye-laws. | Submit registration application before Competent Authority (Housing Department, Salt Lake). | Demand handover of sinking fund and common facility meters from developer. | If promoter sold open parking slots, petition WBRERA and local Municipal Corporation (BMC/HMC).
kolkata_authority_en: KMC Assessment & Building Dept / Competent Authority (New Secretariat)
kolkata_steps_en: Register Flat Owners Association with Competent Authority at New Secretariat Buildings, Kolkata. | Apply to KMC Assessment Dept for mutation of building common facilities to association name. | Submit certified KMC building plan showing open stilts cannot be sold as private units. | WBRERA and KMC declare promoter garage sale deeds void, returning areas to society.
overall_steps_en: Convene general body meeting of flat buyers to adopt statutory Form-A bye-laws. | Submit registration dossier before Competent Authority under Apartment Ownership Act. | Issue legal demand notice to developer to hand over sinking fund and audited accounts. | Move WBRERA Bench to cancel illegal third-party parking sale deeds executed by builder.

title_en: WBRERA Recovery Warrant Execution via DM
relevant_act: Sec 40(1) RERA 2016 r/w Bengal PDR Act, 1913
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified Recovery Certificate under Section 40(1) from the WBRERA Authority. | WBRERA transmits certificate directly to District Magistrate as public demand arrears. | Certificate Officer issues demand notice under Section 7 of Bengal PDR Act, 1913. | If unpaid in 30 days, freeze builder bank accounts and attach real estate inventory.

title_en: Unregistered Real Estate Projects / False Ads
relevant_act: Sec 3 & 59, Real Estate (Regulation & Dev) Act, 2016
overall_steps_en: Verify project details on the official WBRERA portal to confirm lack of registration. | Preserve promotional hoardings, newspaper ads, or brochures lacking RERA numbers. | Submit a formal complaint under Section 59 before the WBRERA Secretary. | WBRERA issues show-cause notice, freezes sales, and levies fines up to 10% of project cost.

title_en: Non-Issuance of Completion (CC) & Occupancy (OC)
relevant_act: Sec 11(4)(b) & 14 RERA r/w KMC / Municipal Acts
overall_steps_en: Verify from municipal borough building office whether builder applied for CC/OC. | Serve a 30-day statutory notice to promoter citing mandatory duty under Section 11(4)(b). | File a complaint before WBRERA or District Consumer Commission for gross service defect. | Secure an order directing promoter to rectify deviations, pay fines, and hand over OC.

title_en: Defective Motor Vehicle & Dealer Fraud
relevant_act: Sec 35, Consumer Protection Act, 2019
overall_steps_en: Preserve all authorized job cards, service workshop slips, and breakdown towing logs. | Issue formal legal notice to automobile manufacturer and authorized dealer. | File complaint on e-Jagriti seeking vehicle replacement or full ex-showroom refund. | Move for independent expert vehicle inspection by Government Engineering College/ARAI.

title_en: Health / Mediclaim Insurance Claim Repudiation
relevant_act: Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017 & CPA, 2019
overall_steps_en: Lodge written appeal with the insurer’s Internal Grievance Cell (GRO) demanding grounds. | If rejected or unanswered in 30 days, register online complaint with Insurance Ombudsman (Kolkata). | Attend physical or virtual hearing with medical bills, discharge summary, and policy wording. | Ombudsman passes binding award within 90 days; insurer must pay within 30 days or face penalty.

title_en: E-Commerce Counterfeit Goods & Refund Refusal
relevant_act: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
overall_steps_en: Record continuous video proof of unboxing and capture screenshots of product labels. | Lodge immediate return complaint on the e-commerce app and save chat transcripts. | Register grievance on National Consumer Helpline (NCH Portal / Call 1915). | If unresolved, file case on e-Jagriti claiming full refund plus compensation.

title_en: Unauthorized Bank Debits & Digital Lending Scams
relevant_act: RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021
overall_steps_en: Report unauthorized electronic transaction to bank within 72 hours for zero customer liability. | Obtain police cyber crime acknowledgment slip from https://cybercrime.gov.in (1930). | If bank fails to reverse debit within 30 days, file complaint on RBI CMS portal. | Banking Ombudsman passes award commanding bank to credit stolen principal plus interest.

title_en: Telecom / Fiber Broadband Service Outage & Billing
relevant_act: Sec 35 CPA, 2019 r/w TRAI QoS Regulations
overall_steps_en: Document daily ticket IDs, customer support emails, and speed test logs showing zero bandwidth. | Invoke TRAI Quality of Service (QoS) rules demanding pro-rata rental credit for downtime. | Escalate to the Appellate Authority of the telecom service provider. | File complaint on e-Jagriti claiming compensation for work-from-home professional disruption.

title_en: Coaching Institute / College Advance Fee Refund
relevant_act: CCPA Guidelines 2024 for Coaching Centers & CPA
overall_steps_en: Submit written course discontinuation letter requesting pro-rata fee refund within 10 days. | Cite CCPA 2024 Guidelines declaring "Non-Refundable Fee" clauses illegal and unfair. | Issue legal demand notice to institute management giving 15-day compliance window. | File consumer case on e-Jagriti; commissions order pro-rata refund plus mental agony relief.

title_en: Airline Flight Delay, Cancellation & Baggage Loss
relevant_act: DGCA Civil Aviation Requirements (CAR) Series M
overall_steps_en: Obtain written Property Irregularity Report (PIR) at airport counter for lost/delayed luggage. | Invoke DGCA CAR Section 3 demanding statutory compensation for delays exceeding 4 hours. | Lodge formal grievance on Ministry of Civil Aviation AirSewa portal attaching boarding passes. | If denied, file consumer complaint on e-Jagriti claiming full luggage replacement and damages.

title_en: Builder Delay in Handing Over Common Facilities
relevant_act: Sec 14 & 18, Real Estate (Regulation & Dev) Act, 2016
overall_steps_en: Collate original marketing brochures and registered agreement listing promised facilities. | Issue joint legal notice by flat owners demanding operational handover within 30 days. | File formal Form-M complaint before WBRERA under Section 31 of the Act. | Secure order imposing daily delay penalty and appointing advocate commissioner to inspect.

title_en: Unilateral Increase in Super Built-Up Area Costs
relevant_act: Sec 11 r/w Carpet Area Rules, RERA, 2016
