overall_steps_en: Hire licensed architect to measure actual RERA usable carpet area. | Issue formal objection refusing escalated charges lacking two-thirds allottee consent. | Lodge online complaint on WBRERA portal citing violation of Section 14(2). | Obtain interim restraint order preventing promoter from canceling flat allotment.

title_en: Structural Cracks & 5-Year Defect Liability
relevant_act: Sec 14(3), Real Estate (Regulation & Dev) Act, 2016
overall_steps_en: Document structural cracks, dampness, and plumbing leaks with date-stamped photographs. | Serve written intimation to developer invoking statutory 5-year defect liability under Section 14(3). | If builder fails to begin repairs in 30 days, file application before WBRERA Adjudicating Officer. | Obtain order directing structural rectification by developer or reimbursement of third-party bills.

title_en: Forfeiture of Booking Token on Home Loan Rejection
relevant_act: CPA, 2019 (Unfair Trade Practices) & RERA Directives
overall_steps_en: Obtain formal Home Loan Rejection Letter from the lending bank specifying ineligibility grounds. | Issue cancellation letter to promoter requesting refund minus minimal admin charges (≤ ₹25,000). | If builder forfeits 10%–20% of total cost, file consumer complaint on https://e-jagriti.gov.in/. | Secure award directing full refund with 9% annual interest for unfair contractual forfeiture.

title_en: Delay in Forming Housing Co-operative Society
relevant_act: Sec 11(4)(e), RERA r/w WB Apartment Ownership Act
overall_steps_en: Convene general body meeting of allottees to pass resolution constituting ad-hoc association. | Submit Form-1 before Competent Authority under WB Apartment Ownership Act for registration. | Serve 15-day requisition notice on builder to transfer unspent sinking fund and audited accounts. | Move WBRERA under Section 31 to impose daily non-compliance penalties until physical handover.

title_en: Twin Allotment Fraud: Same Flat Sold to Multiple Buyers
relevant_act: Sec 18 RERA r/w Sec 316 & 318 BNS, 2023
overall_steps_en: Extract certified registered deeds and index search copies from the Sub-Registrar (ADSR). | Lodge criminal FIR under Section 318(4) BNS for cheating at local police station or EOW. | File urgent petition before WBRERA Bench praying for immediate stay on third-party registry. | Secure award directing full refund with compound interest plus priority alternative flat allotment.

title_en: Health Insurance Rejection for Pre-Existing Diseases
relevant_act: IRDAI Health Insurance Regulations, 2020 & CPA
overall_steps_en: Lodge written grievance with insurer’s Grievance Cell (GRO) demanding itemized repudiation grounds. | Secure treating doctor certificate confirming hospitalized ailment was acute and unrelated. | Cite IRDAI 8-year Moratorium Clause prohibiting repudiation after 8 continuous premium years. | Register online complaint with Insurance Ombudsman (Kolkata); award issued within 3 months.

title_en: Term Life Insurance Denial on Alleged Suicide / Exclusion
relevant_act: Sec 45, Insurance Act, 1938 (Incontestability Clause)
overall_steps_en: Review policy commencement date and verify premiums were paid continuously for 3 years. | Serve legal notice citing Section 45 Insurance Act (prohibiting claim rejection after 3 years). | File formal complaint before State Consumer Commission (SCDRC) or Insurance Ombudsman. | Secure recovery order directing payment of complete sum assured with 9% interest from death date.

title_en: Electric Vehicle (EV) Battery Fire, Explosion & Range Defect
relevant_act: Product Liability (Sec 82–87, Consumer Protection Act, 2019)
overall_steps_en: Secure fire service incident report, battery inspection memo, and police General Diary (GD). | Issue formal statutory legal notice under Section 83 CPA to manufacturer and dealership. | File product liability complaint on e-Jagriti seeking replacement or refund plus damages. | Move for independent laboratory test of battery management system (BMS) via ARAI agency.

title_en: Dark Patterns, Drip Pricing & Stealth Cancellation Fees
relevant_act: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Dark Patterns, 2023
overall_steps_en: Capture screen recordings displaying how ancillary charges were pre-ticked without consent. | Register complaint on National Consumer Helpline portal (https://consumerhelpline.gov.in/) or 1915. | Escalate to CCPA for initiating investigation into systemic unfair trade practices. | File petition before District Consumer Commission for refund of forced add-ons plus damages.

title_en: Refusal of Warranty for Home Appliances
relevant_act: Sec 35, Consumer Protection Act, 2019
overall_steps_en: Save customer care complaint reference numbers, technician visit sheets, and warranty cards. | Send final demand notice to manufacturer nodal officer giving 7-day replacement deadline. | Register online case on e-Jagriti portal attaching invoices and proof of breakdown. | Obtain order directing full invoice refund or replacement with a brand-new unit plus costs.

title_en: Online Furniture & Electronics Damaged in Transit
relevant_act: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
overall_steps_en: Record unboxing video upon delivery and capture photos of damaged items and packaging labels. | Initiate in-app return request within return window; save customer support chat transcripts. | Lodge grievance on National Consumer Helpline (NCH App / Call 1915). | If unresolved in 15 days, file complaint on e-Jagriti against seller and marketplace jointly.

title_en: Foreign Contaminants in Packaged Food & Restaurant Poisoning
relevant_act: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (FSSAI) r/w CPA
authority_forum_en: Food Safety Officer / District Consumer Commission
overall_steps_en: Preserve contaminated food packet, batch number, bill receipt, and seal physical sample. | Secure hospital treatment summaries, blood test reports, and pharmacy bills for poisoning. | File immediate complaint on FSSAI FoSCoS portal (https://foscos.fssai.gov.in/) for lab testing. | File Product Liability claim before DCDRC demanding medical refund, damages, and penalties.

title_en: Laundry & Dry Cleaners Damaging Designer Garments
relevant_act: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Deficiency in Service)
overall_steps_en: Retain original garment purchase invoice and signed receipt voucher from dry cleaner. | Take clear comparative photographs showing chemical burns, color bleeding, or fabric tearing. | Issue legal notice rejecting unilateral receipt limit terms as unfair under Section 2(46) CPA. | File consumer complaint on e-Jagriti claiming current depreciated replacement cost.

title_en: Real Estate Channel Partner / Broker Misrepresentation
relevant_act: Sec 9 & 10, Real Estate (Regulation & Dev) Act, 2016
overall_steps_en: Collate WhatsApp chats, emails, and flyers distributed by channel partner. | Check WBRERA portal to verify whether agent holds an active RERA Registration Number. | File complaint under Section 31 before WBRERA Bench against both agent and developer. | WBRERA initiates license cancellation proceedings and orders refund of commissions.

title_en: Delayed Commercial Retail Space Possession
relevant_act: Sec 18 RERA r/w Commercial Dispute Precedents
overall_steps_en: Review commercial agreement for sale and note promised possession completion date. | Issue legal demand notice for immediate possession or monthly delay interest payout. | File online Form-M complaint before WBRERA Authority claiming ongoing delay interest. | If seeking project exit, pray for complete refund of paid principal with commercial interest.

title_en: Builder Delay in Executing Registered Conveyance Deed
relevant_act: Sec 17 RERA r/w WB Apartment Ownership Act
timeframe_en: Mandatory within 3 months of Occupancy Certificate (OC)
overall_steps_en: Registered association passes resolution demanding execution of Master Conveyance Deed. | Issue 30-day statutory notice to promoter invoking Section 17 of RERA Act. | File non-compliance application before WBRERA Authority for penal action under Section 61. | WBRERA orders promoter to register; upon default, appoints court officer to execute deeds.

title_en: Insurance Repudiation of Commercial Fire / Flood Losses
relevant_act: IRDAI Act, 1999 r/w Consumer Protection Act, 2019
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copies of Fire Brigade Incident Report and police Station Diary records. | Secure complete copy of Insurance Surveyor Loss Assessment Report via formal request. | Rebut unjustified depreciation deductions by engaging an independent licensed Loss Assessor. | File consumer complaint before SCDRC (claims up to ₹10 Crore) or NCDRC for loss recovery.

title_en: Illegal Gold Loan Auctions Without Statutory Notice
relevant_act: RBI Master Directions on Gold Loans r/w Sec 176 Contract Act
overall_steps_en: Produce gold pawn receipts, loan ledger, and verify lack of 14-day registered notice delivery. | Submit complaint on RBI CMS portal alleging violation of Fair Practices Code on Gold Loans. | Lodge case before DCDRC for deficiency of service, undervaluation, and mental harassment. | Obtain order directing NBFC to return equivalent gold ornaments or pay spot market valuation.

title_en: Courier Companies Losing Passports & Certified Deeds
relevant_act: Carriage by Road Act, 2007 r/w CPA, 2019
overall_steps_en: Save tracking logs showing parcel was scanned as "Out for Delivery" or "Lost in Transit". | File police General Diary (GD) for loss of passport, educational degrees, or registered deeds. | Serve legal notice demanding compensation for re-issuance expenses, visa delay, and distress. | File complaint before DCDRC; consumer forums routinely award ₹1 Lakh to ₹5 Lakhs compensation.

title_en: Banks Levying Hidden Foreclosure Charges on Floating Loans
relevant_act: RBI Circulars on Prohibition of Prepayment Penalties
overall_steps_en: Examine loan sanction letter and verify loan is under a floating interest rate regime. | Submit official protest letter to Branch Manager citing RBI Master Circulars banning prepayment fee. | If deducted from foreclosure balance, file complaint on RBI Integrated Ombudsman portal. | Ombudsman directs commercial bank to refund deducted sum with interest and return original deeds.

title_en: Misleading Endorsements by Influencers & Celebrities
relevant_act: Sec 21 & 89, CPA, 2019 & CCPA Guidelines
overall_steps_en: Archive promotional videos, Instagram posts, and misleading product claims before deletion. | Submit a formal complaint dossier to Central Consumer Protection Authority (ccpa-ca@nic.in). | CCPA Director General conducts preliminary probe into substantiation of scientific claims. | CCPA issues orders banning ad and imposing fines up to ₹10 Lakhs on the endorser.

title_en: Wedding Banquet Hall & Event Cancellation Forfeitures
relevant_act: Sec 35 CPA, 2019 r/w Sec 74 Contract Act
overall_steps_en: Produce booking receipts, cancellation correspondence, and written notice sent to hall. | Issue legal demand notice showing venue was informed with sufficient advance notice (30+ days). | File consumer case on e-Jagriti challenging total forfeiture clause as unfair under Section 2(46). | Obtain award ordering refund minus documented direct expenses incurred by banquet management.

title_en: Spurious Seeds & Adulterated Pesticides Crop Failure
relevant_act: Seeds Act, 1966 r/w Consumer Protection Act, 2019
overall_steps_en: Retain seed packet, batch tags, cash memo bill, and empty chemical containers. | Request local Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) to conduct on-site field inspection. | Agricultural Officer submits certified report establishing failure was caused by seed defect. | File complaint before DCDRC claiming projected market yield value of crop plus input costs.

title_en: Builder Failure to Provide Drinking Water Connection
relevant_act: Sec 11 RERA r/w Municipal Water Supply Rules
overall_steps_en: Collate monthly society accounts showing expenses paid to private water tanker suppliers. | Serve demand notice on promoter to complete municipal water supply pipework within 15 days. | File petition before WBRERA under Section 31 for failing to deliver essential infrastructure. | Secure order directing builder to reimburse monthly tanker bills until municipal commissioning.

title_en: Unlawful Sale of Stilt Parking & Open Terraces by Promoters
relevant_act: Nahalchand Laloochand (SC) r/w RERA, 2016
overall_steps_en: Inspect approved municipal building plan; open stilt areas and roofs cannot be sold as units. | Pass resolution in Apartment Association challenging third-party occupancy of common parking. | File application before WBRERA Bench for invalidation of separate stilt/roof sale deeds. | WBRERA declares common areas belong exclusively to registered apartment association.

title_en: Arbitrary Gym & Salon Multi-Year Membership Lock-ins
relevant_act: CPA, 2019 (Unfair Contract Terms, Sec 2(46))
overall_steps_en: Save original membership agreements, payment receipts, and promotional lists of amenities. | Document facility deficiencies: broken equipment, absent trainers, or unannounced branch relocations. | Submit formal written refund request for remaining unutilized subscription period. | File complaint on e-Jagriti; consumer forums routinely void "non-refundable" clauses as unfair.

title_en: International Package Tour Operators Stranding Tourists
relevant_act: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Deficiency in Service)
overall_steps_en: Preserve original signed tour itinerary, hotel vouchers, and extra receipts paid abroad. | Take photographs and videos showing substandard hotel rooms or lack of guided transport. | Serve statutory legal notice on travel operator demanding expense reimbursements. | File consumer complaint on e-Jagriti claiming refund of tour margins, expenses, and damages.

title_en: Refusal of Warranty for Lack of Paper Bill Despite Digital SMS
relevant_act: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules & IT Act Sec 4
overall_steps_en: Retrieve digital tax invoice, order confirmation email, or brand registration SMS. | Submit gadget to authorized service center; if rejected, demand a written rejection slip. | File complaint on National Consumer Helpline citing Section 4 of IT Act (electronic record validity). | If service is denied, move DCDRC for order directing free replacement and damages.

title_en: Matrimonial Apps & Fraudulent Profile Matchmaking Scams
relevant_act: IT Act, 2000 r/w Section 35, CPA, 2019
authority_forum_en: Cyber Crime Police (1930) / District Consumer Commission
timeframe_en: Immediate cyber action; 60 days consumer disposal
overall_steps_en: Preserve screenshots of fraudulent profile, membership payment invoices, and all chat records. | File emergency complaint on National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (https://cybercrime.gov.in) or 1930. | Serve legal notice on platform Grievance Officer for failure of due diligence under Intermediary Rules. | File complaint before DCDRC for full refund of premium charges and mental harassment damages.

title_en: Cloud Storage Outages & Critical Data Loss for Small Firms
relevant_act: IT Act r/w Consumer Protection Act (Commercial Defect)
authority_forum_en: Adjudicating Officer (IT Act) / Commercial Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Document server downtime logs, error monitoring screenshots, and all support tickets raised. | Quantify direct financial losses: lost client orders, payroll disruption, and third-party recovery bills. | Serve formal dispute notice citing breach of contractual uptime guarantees (99.9% availability). | File petition before State IT Secretary Adjudicating Officer or Commercial Court for compensation.

title_en: Credit Card Fraud & Denial of Zero-Liability Protection
relevant_act: RBI Limiting Liability Circular on Electronic Transactions
timeframe_en: Report in 3 days; 30 days Ombudsman disposal
overall_steps_en: Block credit card immediately via mobile app and lodge emergency fraud dispute within 72 hours. | File online cyber complaint on National Cyber Crime Portal and secure acknowledgment. | If bank insists on payment and levies interest, submit formal dispute citing RBI Zero-Liability Mandate. | Escalate to RBI Ombudsman; banks cannot hold customers liable for breaches reported in 3 days.

title_en: Severe Medical Malpractice: Wrong Surgery & Foreign Object Left Inside
relevant_act: CPA, 2019 r/w Jacob Mathew (SC) & Res Ipsa Loquitur
overall_steps_en: Secure certified clinical charts, operative notes, and discovery X-ray/CT scan films. | Lodge emergency complaint before West Bengal Clinical Establishments Commission (WBCERC). | File complaint with State Medical Council for inquiry into surgeon’s medical license. | Institute high-value claim before SCDRC or NCDRC claiming full expense refund and lifetime disability relief.

title_en: De-Registration of Defaulting RERA Project & Escrow Seizure
relevant_act: Sec 7 & 8, Real Estate (Regulation & Dev) Act, 2016
overall_steps_en: Allottees Association passes special resolution showing promoter abandoned construction for 1+ year. | Submit application before WBRERA Authority praying for project de-registration under Section 7. | WBRERA freezes project 70% designated RERA escrow bank accounts. | Authority invokes Section 8, assigning development rights to buyers association to finish flats.

title_en: Allottees Association Class Action Complaint Before State Commission
relevant_act: Sec 35(1)(c), Consumer Protection Act, 2019
authority_forum_en: State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (SCDRC, Kolkata)
overall_steps_en: Pass executive committee resolution authorizing office bearers to represent all buyers in a unified docket. | Prepare consolidated schedule of all member flat numbers, payment receipts, and default timelines. | File Joint Complaint before SCDRC with application seeking leave to proceed as a Class Action. | Secure collective judgment directing standardized delay interest or execution of common conveyance.

title_en: Ancestral Property Partition Suit
relevant_act: Order XX Rule 18 & Order XXVI, CPC, 1908
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Senior / Junior Division) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Trace complete genealogy (Warishan tree) from common ancestor and collect chain deeds. | Serve statutory legal notice for partition through an advocate demanding amicable division. | File Partition Suit under Order XX Rule 18 CPC praying for preliminary decree of shares. | Apply for appointment of Partition Commissioner under Order XXVI to carve out physical Takhtas.

title_en: Voluntary Probate (Post-2025 Sec 213 ISA Omission)
relevant_act: Indian Succession Act, 1925 (Post-2025 Sec 213 Omission)
rural_authority_en: Court of District Judge / District Delegate (22 Districts)
rural_steps_en: Locate original Will and obtain death certificate of testator from local registrar. | File Probate Petition before District Judge supported by affidavits of attesting witnesses. | Court issues general citations in local district newspapers and special summons to legal heirs. | Upon recording witness testimony and in absence of caveats, District Judge issues Probate.
kolkata_authority_en: High Court at Calcutta (Testamentary & Intestate Jurisdiction - Original Side)
kolkata_steps_en: File Probate Application before Master / Registrar of Original Side of High Court at Calcutta. | Submit registered Will with supporting affidavits from at least one surviving attesting witness. | High Court issues citations published in English and Bengali state-level newspapers. | High Court passes formal Letters of Probate under the Seal of the High Court.
overall_steps_en: Locate original registered or unregistered Will along with testator death certificate. | File Probate Petition before District Judge or High Court supported by attesting witness affidavits. | Court issues general citations in newspapers and special citations to all legal heirs. | Upon recording witness evidence and lack of caveat, court grants Letters of Probate under official seal.

title_en: Succession Certificate for Bank Accounts & Shares
relevant_act: Sec 372, Indian Succession Act, 1925
overall_steps_en: Collect schedule of debts and securities: bank account numbers, FD balances, and Demat statements. | File petition under Section 372 ISA before Civil Judge (Senior Division) with family tree. | Court publishes statutory notification in local newspapers inviting objections within 45 days. | Pay requisite ad-valorem judicial court fee stamps and receive authenticated Succession Certificate.

title_en: Letters of Administration for Intestate Estates
relevant_act: Sec 278, Indian Succession Act, 1925
rural_authority_en: Court of District & Sessions Judge (District Headquarters)
rural_steps_en: Prepare schedule of all immovable lands/houses situated within the district. | File Section 278 petition before District Judge asserting deceased died intestate. | District Judge issues special citations to all legal heirs and publishes in district dailies. | Execute Administration Bond with sureties; receive Letters of Administration under seal.
kolkata_authority_en: High Court at Calcutta (Original Civil Jurisdiction)
kolkata_steps_en: Prepare multi-property asset schedule situated in Kolkata municipal limits. | File petition under Section 278 ISA before Original Side of High Court at Calcutta. | Court issues citations published in English and Bengali state-level newspapers. | High Court executes Administration Bond and issues Letters of Administration under court seal.
overall_steps_en: Prepare comprehensive schedule of all immovable real estate and movable assets left by deceased. | File petition under Section 278 ISA before District Judge or High Court asserting intestacy. | Court issues citations to all natural heirs and publishes notices in English and Bengali newspapers. | Execute Administration Bond with sureties; court issues Letters of Administration under seal.

title_en: Warishan Certificate vs Court Succession Certificate
relevant_act: Legal Heirship Rules & Indian Succession Act
rural_authority_en: Gram Panchayat Pradhan / Municipality Chairman / BL&LRO
rural_steps_en: Apply to Gram Panchayat Pradhan or Municipality Chairman for official Warishan Certificate. | Produce family tree affidavit, death certificate, and voter card proofs of all children. | Use verified Warishan Certificate to apply for land mutation on Banglarbhumi. | If bank rejects Warishan for releasing deposits, file Section 372 ISA petition before Civil Judge.
kolkata_authority_en: KMC Borough Office (Ward Councillor) / City Civil Court
kolkata_steps_en: Obtain Legal Heir / Family Certificate attested by local KMC Ward Councillor. | Submit heirship documents to KMC Assessment Dept to update municipal property records. | If bank requires formal judicial succession for shares/deposits, move City Civil Court. | City Civil Court issues official Succession Certificate under Section 372 ISA.
overall_steps_en: Assess requirement: apply for local Warishan Certificate for mutating family land in Banglarbhumi. | Obtain verification signatures from ward councillor or Gram Panchayat Pradhan with family tree. | If bank or mutual fund rejects Warishan due to lack of nomination, initiate court proceedings. | File Section 372 ISA petition before Civil Judge to obtain conclusive judicial Succession Certificate.

title_en: Injunction against Co-sharer Selling Joint Land
relevant_act: Order XXXIX Rules 1 & 2 r/w Sec 151 CPC
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Partition Trial Court) / City Civil Court
timeframe_en: Urgent (7 to 15 days for ad-interim stay)
overall_steps_en: File an urgent Interim Injunction Application under Order XXXIX Rules 1 & 2 CPC in partition suit. | Demonstrate prima facie title, balance of convenience, and irreparable loss if land is alienated. | Obtain ex-parte ad-interim Status Quo order restraining co-sharers from selling or developing. | Serve certified copy of injunction directly on local Sub-Registrar (ADSR) to block registry deeds.

title_en: Partition Commissioner & Final Takhta Division
relevant_act: Order XXVI Rules 13 & 14 r/w Order XX CPC
overall_steps_en: Apply for appointment of Partition Commissioner under Order XXVI Rule 13 after preliminary decree. | Deposit commissioner costs and attend on-site physical survey with surveying chains/instruments. | Commissioner prepares field map, carves separate lots (Takhtas), and submits written report. | Court invites objections; upon approval, judge signs the Final Partition Decree on non-judicial stamp.

title_en: Hindu Daughter’s Coparcenary Share in Joint Estate
relevant_act: Sec 6, Hindu Succession Act, 1956 (Vineeta Sharma SC)
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Senior / Junior Division) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Prove biological daughter relationship through birth certificate, school records, or voter card. | Issue legal notice to brothers demanding equal coparcenary share citing *Vineeta Sharma (SC)*. | File Partition Suit under Section 6 HSA; brothers cannot plead daughter married before 2005. | Court passes preliminary decree awarding daughter an identical share to that of a son.

title_en: Muslim Law of Inheritance, Hiba & Partition
relevant_act: Principles of Mohammedan Law r/w Specific Relief Act
overall_steps_en: Calculate fixed Quranic shares (Sharers: widow 1/8th or 1/4th, daughters, mother 1/6th). | If brothers claim oral Hiba (gift), demand strict proof of declaration, acceptance, and possession. | File Partition Suit before Civil Judge praying for division strictly per Mohammedan law. | Court strikes down unproved oral gifts and partitions estate among all Sharers and Residuaries.

title_en: Revocation of Registered Gift Deed by Senior Citizens
relevant_act: Sec 23, Maintenance & Welfare of Parents Act, 2007
rural_authority_en: Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) Maintenance Tribunal (22 Districts)
rural_steps_en: Verify gift deed of district agricultural/homestead land had basic caregiving expectation. | File petition under Section 23 before SDO Tribunal citing physical and financial neglect. | SDO summons adult children and conducts summary inquiry within 30 days. | SDO declares gift deed void; directs district Sub-Registrar and BL&LRO to cancel mutation.
kolkata_authority_en: Kolkata District Maintenance Tribunal (Collectorate at Bankshall St)
kolkata_steps_en: Submit Section 23 petition before Kolkata Maintenance Tribunal at Collectorate Office. | Attach registered gift deed of Kolkata flat/premises and medical bills proving neglect. | Tribunal conducts hearing and passes order annulling gift deed executed under undue influence. | Order transmitted directly to KMC Assessment Dept to restore Assessee Card in parent name.
overall_steps_en: Verify gift deed was executed after commencement of the 2007 Act with conditional caregiving. | File an application under Section 23 before the SDO Maintenance Tribunal citing neglect. | SDO summons adult child and conducts summary hearing into physical and financial abandonment. | SDO declares gift deed void as procured by fraud; directs Sub-Registrar to cancel deed entries.

title_en: Will Challenge for Forgery & Undue Influence
relevant_act: Sec 61 & 63, ISA, 1925 & Sec 68 Evidence Act
authority_forum_en: District Judge Court / High Court at Calcutta
overall_steps_en: File caveat in probate court immediately upon learning of suspicious will petition. | Obtain hospital medical charts proving testator was unconscious or lacked mental capacity. | Cross-examine propounder to expose that attesting witnesses never saw testator sign. | Court dismisses probate petition, declaring will fabricated and restoring natural succession.

title_en: Mutual Family Settlement Deed (Aposh-Bontonnama)
relevant_act: Sec 17, Registration Act, 1908 & Transfer of Property Act
rural_authority_en: Sub-Registrar (ADSR) & BL&LRO Survey Wing
rural_steps_en: Engage licensed revenue Amin to survey joint rural/district plots and prepare lot map (Takhtas). | Draft Family Settlement Deed specifying clear Dag boundaries, road passages, and acreage. | Execute and register deed before jurisdictional Sub-Registrar (ADSR). | Submit registered deed to BL&LRO for separate Khatian generation and Batag plot creation.
kolkata_authority_en: Registrar of Assurances (ARA Kolkata) & KMC Assessment Dept
kolkata_steps_en: Engage KMC licensed building surveyor to draft architectural floor-wise partition plan. | Execute registered Family Settlement Deed at Additional Registrar of Assurances (ARA Kolkata). | Submit registered partition deed to KMC Assessment & Collection Dept for separation of premises. | KMC issues independent Assessee Numbers and separate municipal tax bills for each family branch.
overall_steps_en: Engage licensed Amin to survey joint property and draw colored lot maps (Takhtas) for each heir. | Draft formal Family Settlement Deed clearly defining individual Dag boundaries and road shares. | Execute deed before jurisdictional Sub-Registrar (ADSR) with all co-sharers signing. | Submit registered deed copy to BL&LRO for separate mutation and independent Khatian generation.

title_en: Shebaiti Rights & Debottar Temple Estate Dispute
relevant_act: Sec 92 CPC & Religious Endowments Precedents
authority_forum_en: District Judge / High Court at Calcutta
overall_steps_en: Extract original Arpannama / Debottar Dedication Deed establishing perpetual dedication to deity. | If a Shebait sells idol land, move court under Section 92 CPC for removal of Shebait. | Obtain injunction declaring temple property non-alienable and canceling third-party transfers. | Court frames a formal Scheme of Administration regulating rotating turns of worship (Pala).

title_en: Inheritance Rights of Children from Void Marriages
relevant_act: Sec 16(3), Hindu Marriage Act (Revanasiddappa SC)
overall_steps_en: Prove biological parentage through birth certificates, school admission forms, or Aadhaar cards. | Cite Supreme Court *Revanasiddappa* ruling confirming children inherit parent’s ancestral share. | File Civil Suit for Partition claiming equal division of father’s undivided coparcenary interest. | Court passes decree allotting children of second marriage equal shares alongside marital children.

title_en: Nominee vs Legal Heir Dispute in Bank Deposits
relevant_act: Banking Regulation Act (Sarbati Devi Precedent)
overall_steps_en: Serve immediate legal notice on the bank and Nominee asserting trust status under *Sarbati Devi*. | File an injunction suit restraining the bank from disbursing entire funds exclusively to Nominee. | File a petition for Succession Certificate (Sec 372 ISA) or partition suit for estate division. | Court orders funds distributed proportionately among all Class-I heirs irrespective of nomination.

title_en: Christian Intestate & Testamentary Succession
relevant_act: Sec 31–49, Indian Succession Act, 1925
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified death certificate of deceased and church baptismal family records. | Prepare inventory of all movable and immovable estate properties situated in West Bengal. | File Civil Suit for Partition or Letters of Administration under Section 278 ISA. | Court confirms daughters and sons inherit equal shares under Section 37, drawing final decree.

title_en: Parsi Intestate & Testamentary Succession Rights
relevant_act: Sec 50–56, Indian Succession Act, 1925
authority_forum_en: High Court at Calcutta (Original Civil Jurisdiction)
overall_steps_en: Secure death certificate from KMC alongside Parsi Zoroastrian Anjuman enrollment certificate. | File petition for Letters of Administration or Probate before High Court Original Side. | Issue citations in English and vernacular newspapers notifying surviving Parsi heirs. | Court partitions estate per Section 51, allotting equal shares to spouse, sons, and daughters.

title_en: Living Will & Advance Medical Directive Enforcement
relevant_act: Common Cause v. UOI (SC Constitutional Bench)
authority_forum_en: Judicial Magistrate First Class (JMFC) / Medical Board
timeframe_en: Immediate execution during terminal medical emergencies
overall_steps_en: Draft Living Will specifying medical instructions in presence of two independent witnesses. | Execute directive before Judicial Magistrate First Class (JMFC) who countersigns document. | JMFC records copy in digital repository and forwards copy to Chief Medical Officer (CMOH). | In terminal coma, hospital Primary and Secondary Medical Boards inspect directive to execute.

title_en: Substitution of Legal Heirs on Death of Co-Sharer in Partition
relevant_act: Order XXII Rules 3 & 4, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
authority_forum_en: Civil Court hearing the active Partition Suit
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified death certificate of deceased co-sharer from municipal authority. | Prepare amended genealogical family tree (Warishan) listing all surviving Class-I legal heirs. | File application under Order XXII Rule 3 (plaintiff) or Rule 4 (defendant) CPC within 90 days. | If delayed past 90 days, file Section 5 Limitation Act petition to set aside suit abatement.

title_en: Rights of Adopted Child in Ancestral vs Self-Acquired Property
relevant_act: Sec 12, Hindu Adoptions & Maintenance Act, 1956 (HAMA)
overall_steps_en: Produce registered Deed of Adoption executed in compliance with Section 16 HAMA. | If biological siblings exclude adopted child, serve statutory legal notice asserting rights. | File Civil Suit for Partition claiming equal coparcenary share alongside biological children. | Court passes preliminary decree confirming adopted child holds identical inheritance status.

title_en: Inheritance Rights of Stepmother & Stepchildren
relevant_act: Hindu Succession Act, 1956 r/w General Succession
overall_steps_en: Establish legal marital status of stepmother with deceased father through marriage records. | Exclude stepchildren from claims over stepmother’s individual self-acquired property. | If stepbrothers attempt total exclusion from father’s estate, file Partition Plaint. | Court draws preliminary decree allotting shares strictly per statutory biological devolution.

title_en: Setting Aside Gift Deeds Procured by Coercion or Fraud
relevant_act: Sec 19 Contract Act r/w Sec 31, Specific Relief Act, 1963
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Senior Division) / City Civil Court
timeframe_en: Within 3 years of discovering the fraud
overall_steps_en: Apply for certified copies of challenged gift deed from Sub-Registrar Office (ADSR). | Collect hospital records proving donor suffered cognitive impairment or was bedridden. | File Suit for Cancellation of Instrument under Section 31 SRA, praying deed be declared void. | Secure interim injunction restraining recipient relative from selling or mortgaging land.

title_en: Inheritance Rights in Inter-Faith Civil Marriages
relevant_act: Sec 21 & 21A, Special Marriage Act, 1954 (SMA) r/w ISA
overall_steps_en: Produce registered Special Marriage Certificate issued by District Marriage Officer. | Verify Section 21 SMA applies: personal religious laws are superseded by Indian Succession Act. | File petition for Letters of Administration or Partition under Indian Succession Act, 1925. | Court partitions estate ensuring secular distribution among spouse and children.

title_en: Cancellation of Deceptively Obtained Relinquishment Deed
relevant_act: Sec 31, Specific Relief Act, 1963 r/w Registration Act
timeframe_en: Within 3 years of discovering the fraud
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copy of registered Relinquishment Deed from ADSR registry archives. | Prove deed lacked valid consideration and signature was obtained through misrepresentation. | File Civil Suit for Declaration that Relinquishment Deed is null and void. | Move for injunction restraining brothers from mutating land exclusively in Banglarbhumi or KMC.

title_en: Disinheriting Natural Heirs: Inofficious Will Claims
relevant_act: Sec 61, Indian Succession Act, 1925
authority_forum_en: Probate Court / District Judge / High Court
timeframe_en: Raised in probate caveat (Within 30 days of service)
overall_steps_en: File formal Caveat under Section 284 ISA in probate court upon learning of probate petition. | Submit Affidavit in Support of Caveat raising unnatural disposition without explanation in Will. | Challenge mental capacity of testator and examine propounder regarding suspicious beneficiary role. | Court converts probate into Contentious Civil Suit, requiring strict proof of testamentary capacity.

title_en: Multi-State Estate Administration & Ancillary Letters
relevant_act: Sec 270 & 273, Indian Succession Act, 1925
authority_forum_en: High Court at Calcutta (Original Civil Jurisdiction)
overall_steps_en: Prepare comprehensive asset inventory listing property coordinates across West Bengal and other states. | File petition under Section 270 ISA before High Court where deceased had permanent abode. | Pray for explicit endorsement under Section 273 extending grant across all states in India. | Use single certified High Court grant to mutate properties directly before other state registries.

title_en: Probate of Lost, Destroyed or Burned Wills
relevant_act: Sec 237–240, Indian Succession Act, 1925
authority_forum_en: District Judge / High Court at Calcutta
overall_steps_en: Retrieve drafts, photocopies, or digital Word/PDF scans preserved by drafting advocate. | File petition under Section 237 or 238 ISA for probate of Will limited until original is produced. | Examine drafting lawyer and attesting witnesses to prove due execution and lack of intent to revoke. | Court issues limited probate confirming reconstructed text as authentic last testamentary Will.

title_en: Oral (Nuncupative) Wills for Soldiers & Defense Personnel
relevant_act: Sec 66, Indian Succession Act, 1925 (Privileged Wills)
overall_steps_en: Collect military service records proving deceased soldier was deployed on active expedition. | Secure sworn affidavits from two independent witnesses who heard deceased speak wishes aloud. | File petition for Letters of Administration with oral Will annexed under Section 66 ISA. | Court dispenses with formal written execution formalities and issues administration rights.

title_en: Partition of Family Business Assets & Firm Goodwill
relevant_act: Sec 44, Indian Partnership Act, 1932 & Order XX Rule 15 CPC
overall_steps_en: File Civil Suit for Dissolution of Partnership and Division of Family Business Assets. | Move urgent application under Order XL CPC for appointment of a Court Receiver over daily cash counters. | Court appoints Chartered Accountant to value brand goodwill, stocks, and intellectual property. | Pass preliminary decree either auctioning business internally between family branches or dividing sale sum.

title_en: Benami Land Claims Among Brothers & Joint Family Funds
relevant_act: Sec 4(3)(b), Benami Act r/w Hindu Law Principles
overall_steps_en: Compile financial records demonstrating named brother had no independent personal income. | Produce joint family business bank statements showing consideration cheques cleared from joint funds. | Frame specific issue in partition suit asserting exemption under Section 4(3)(b) (fiduciary capacity). | Court passes preliminary partition decree treating disputed asset as joint ancestral property.

title_en: Agricultural Land Inheritance vs Fragment Ceiling Laws
relevant_act: State Consolidation of Holdings Regulations r/w WBLR Act
overall_steps_en: Calculate whether dividing the Dag number among all heirs breaches statutory fragmentation limits. | If fragmentation is barred, invoke buy-out valuation provisions under Section 3 Partition Act, 1893. | One co-sharer applies to buy out fractional shares of siblings at prevailing circle valuation. | Revenue Officer enters undivided fractional shares in Khatian to preserve single physical plot unit.

title_en: Creation & Revocation of Private Family Trusts
relevant_act: Indian Trusts Act, 1882
timeframe_en: 15 to 30 days registration; 6 months for court suit
overall_steps_en: Draft formal Trust Deed identifying Settlor, Trustees, Beneficiaries, and specific distribution triggers. | Execute and register Trust Deed before jurisdictional Sub-Registrar (ADSR) paying state stamp duty. | Transfer scheduled properties from personal name to the Trust entity via registered conveyance. | If seeking revocation, file application under Section 77 Trusts Act proving trust objectives are fulfilled.

title_en: Right of Pre-emption in Inherited Family Dwelling
relevant_act: Sec 4, Partition Act, 1893
timeframe_en: Raised during trial; 30 to 60 days disposal
overall_steps_en: Verify property is a continuous family dwelling house and outsider purchaser has joined suit. | File application under Section 4 Partition Act expressing unconditional willingness to buy out share. | Pray for independent valuation by court-appointed commissioner to assess fair market price of fraction. | Deposit purchase money into court; obtain registered sale certificate transferring share back to family.

title_en: Exclusion from Inheritance on Ground of Murder of Property Owner
relevant_act: Sec 25 & 27, Hindu Succession Act, 1956
authority_forum_en: Civil Court hearing Partition / Succession suit
timeframe_en: Raised in active trial; conclusive upon criminal judgment
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copies of criminal charge sheet and conviction judgment under Section 103 BNS. | File application under Section 25 HSA in pending partition suit praying for statutory disqualification. | Establish that under Section 27, the murderer cannot transmit any coparcenary rights to their line. | Secure preliminary decree redistributing entire holding exclusively among surviving innocent heirs.

title_en: Inheritance Rights of Non-Marital (Illegitimate) Children
relevant_act: Revanasiddappa v. Mallikarjun (SC 2023) r/w Sec 16(3) HMA
overall_steps_en: Establish biological paternity through birth registration, school records, or DNA orders under Section 114 BSA. | Cite landmark *Revanasiddappa (SC)* precedent confirming children inherit from parents ancestral share. | File Civil Suit for Partition praying for allotment of deceased parents notional coparcenary share. | Secure preliminary decree dividing parents undivided share equally among marital and non-marital children.

title_en: Unilateral Family Settlement Favoring One Sibling
relevant_act: Sec 6, Hindu Succession Act (Vineeta Sharma) r/w SRA
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copies of contested family settlement or partition deed from Sub-Registrar (ADSR). | Issue legal notice asserting equal coparcenary co-ownership under amended Section 6 HSA. | File Civil Suit for Declaration that unilateral partition deed is void and non-binding on daughter. | Move application for injunction restraining mutation in Banglarbhumi and halting construction.

title_en: Appointment of Court Receiver to Collect Joint Rents
relevant_act: Order XL Rules 1–5, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
overall_steps_en: Compile evidence demonstrating one co-sharer is exclusively pocketing commercial tenant rents. | File interim application under Order XL Rule 1 CPC for appointment of independent Court Receiver. | Court appoints advocate receiver authorized to collect monthly rents, issue receipts, and bank funds. | Accumulated rental funds are distributed among all co-sharers strictly per final partition decree.

title_en: Allocation of Ancestral Debts & Mortgages in Partition
relevant_act: Mitakshara Principle of Pious Obligation r/w Sec 6 HSA
overall_steps_en: Collate loan sanction letters, bank statements, and KCC loan liability certificates of deceased. | Draft itemized schedule of ancestral liabilities and attach to partition plaint or written statement. | Court adjudicates whether debts were for family necessity or immoral purposes (Avyavaharika). | Final decree mandates legitimate debts be paid from joint estate before physical division.

title_en: Inventory & Partition of Bank Lockers & Movable Heirlooms
relevant_act: Order XXVI Rules 13 & 14, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
overall_steps_en: Identify ancestral safe deposit lockers held in commercial banks in deceased parent name. | File application under Order XXVI CPC for Advocate Commissioner to open locker before all heirs. | Commissioner prepares video-recorded inventory and engages approved jeweler to assess purity/weight. | Submit verified inventory report to court to distribute heirlooms via agreed lots or auction proceeds.

title_en: Rights of Posthumous Child Born After Instituted Partition
relevant_act: Sec 20, Hindu Succession Act, 1956
overall_steps_en: Obtain municipal birth certificate proving conception occurred prior to father demise or decree. | File application under Section 151 and Order I Rule 10 CPC through natural guardian to implead child. | Cite Section 20 HSA (a child in womb at time of death is deemed born before the death). | Court amends preliminary partition decree, recalculating shares to allot equal portion to child.

title_en: Will Executed Under Mysterious Circumstances
relevant_act: H. Venkatachala Iyengar (SC) r/w Sec 63 ISA
authority_forum_en: District Judge Court / High Court at Calcutta
overall_steps_en: File caveat and written objection in probate highlighting suspicious factors (ICU execution). | Summon hospital admission registers and doctor bed-head tickets regarding testator consciousness. | Cross-examine propounder and witnesses regarding discrepancy in signatures and thumbprints. | Probate court refuses probate where propounder fails to dispel grave suspicious circumstances.

title_en: Succession to Estates of Childless Unmarried Persons
relevant_act: Sec 8, 9 & 15, Hindu Succession Act, 1956
overall_steps_en: Secure death certificate and verify deceased was unmarried and left no Class-I descendants. | Map Class-II heirs under Section 8: father, mother, followed by brothers and sisters equally. | File application for Succession Certificate or Legal Heirship Certificate before civil court. | Court issues succession grant allowing siblings to liquidate accounts and mutate real estate.

title_en: Partition of Real Estate with Pre-existing Bank Mortgage
relevant_act: Order XXXIV, CPC r/w Transfer of Property Act, 1882
overall_steps_en: Obtain bank loan sanction letter identifying specific mortgaged fraction and outstanding debt. | Implead lending bank as formal party under Order I Rule 10 CPC in the partition suit. | Pray for court to carve out defaulting co-sharer lot and shift bank mortgage lien strictly onto it. | Secure final partition decree granting unencumbered, mortgage-free title of remaining lots to others.

title_en: Absolute Ownership Rights of Hindu Widows
relevant_act: Sec 14(1), Hindu Succession Act, 1956
authority_forum_en: Civil Court / City Civil Court at Calcutta
overall_steps_en: Produce title deeds and revenue Porchas proving female Hindu was in lawful possession. | Cite Section 14(1) HSA: property possessed by female Hindu matures into absolute ownership. | File Written Statement or Plaint asserting full right to sell, gift, or bequeath without in-law nod. | Secure declaratory decree dismissing reversionary suits brought by brothers-in-law.

title_en: Succession of Digital Assets, Royalties & Intellectual Property
relevant_act: Copyright Act, 1957 r/w Sec 370, Indian Succession Act
overall_steps_en: Compile itemized digital asset schedule including copyright registration numbers and royalty logs. | File petition for Succession Certificate under Section 372 ISA specifically listing intangible debts. | Serve notice on intellectual property collecting societies (IPRS, PPL) and digital publishing platforms. | Submit final Succession Certificate to digital platforms to transfer revenue accounts to legal heirs.

title_en: Family Settlement Challenged by Non-Signatory Legal Heir
relevant_act: Indian Contract Act, 1872 r/w Specific Relief Act
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Senior Division) / City Civil Court
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copies of registered family arrangement deed (Aposh-Bontonnama) from ADSR. | File Civil Suit for Declaration that settlement deed is void ab initio against non-signatory plaintiff. | Establish that an unpartitioned coparcenary cannot be dissolved without consensus of all co-owners. | Secure order canceling fraudulent deed and initiating a fresh judicial partition under Order XX CPC.

title_en: Mohammedan Law Rule on Bequests Capped at One-Third
relevant_act: Principles of Mohammedan Law (Wasaya / Will Rules)
overall_steps_en: Quantify net estate value after deducting funeral expenses, debts, and dower (Mahr) liabilities. | Challenge any bequest exceeding one-third (1/3) of net estate as ultra vires Mohammedan law. | File Suit for Partition asserting excess two-thirds must devolve strictly per Quranic shares. | Court limits legatee share to maximum one-third and partitions remaining two-thirds among heirs.

title_en: Revocation of Succession Certificate for Fraudulent Concealment
relevant_act: Sec 383, Indian Succession Act, 1925
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Senior Division) which granted original certificate
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copies of succession certificate petition, citations, and order sheet from court. | File Revocation Petition under Section 383 ISA proving grant was obtained by untrue allegations of fact. | Present government Warishan certificates proving applicant was a surviving Class-I heir omitted deliberately. | Court revokes certificate, freezes bank accounts, and directs fraudulent petitioner to deposit funds.

title_en: Customary Tribal Succession vs Non-Applicability of HSA
relevant_act: Sec 2(2), Hindu Succession Act, 1956 r/w Chota Nagpur / Santhal Tenancy
authority_forum_en: Civil Court / Special Tribal Revenue Authority
overall_steps_en: Establish membership in a notified Scheduled Tribe under Article 342 of Constitution of India. | Invoke Section 2(2) HSA, demonstrating that general statutory Hindu succession does not apply. | Produce evidence of prevailing patriarchal tribal customs (e.g. lineage maintenance for daughters). | Civil court partitions estate in strict compliance with validated customary tribal jurisprudence.

title_en: Rights of Minor Co-sharers in Family Partition
relevant_act: Sec 8, Hindu Minority & Guardianship Act, 1956 r/w Order XXXII CPC
timeframe_en: Within 3 years of minor attaining age 18 (Majority)
overall_steps_en: Calculate minor fractional entitlement compared to the substandard lot allotted in prior partition. | File Suit to Set Aside Partition through next friend or within 3 years of attaining majority (Sec 6 Limitation). | Prove guardians failed to obtain prior court permission under Section 8 HMGA for minor disposition. | Court annuls previous division and orders an equitable re-partition and fresh takhta distribution.

title_en: Cheque Dishonour Criminal Complaint (Bankshall vs District Courts)
relevant_act: Sec 138 & 142, Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
timeframe_en: 30 days notice; 15 days cure; 30 days filing window
rural_authority_en: Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM) / JMFC in District Courts
rural_steps_en: Obtain Cheque Return Memo from district bank branch stating "Funds Insufficient". | Serve statutory demand notice under Section 138(b) via registered post within 30 days. | Wait 15 days for drawer to make payment; cause of action arises on 16th day. | File criminal complaint before Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM) in District Court (Alipore, Barasat, etc.).
kolkata_authority_en: Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (CMM), Bankshall Court, Kolkata
kolkata_steps_en: Collect bank return memo from Kolkata bank branch confirming dishonour. | Serve statutory 30-day legal notice under Section 138 NI Act to drawer address in Kolkata. | Wait 15 days; if unpaid, draft criminal complaint under Section 142 NI Act. | File complaint before Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (CMM) at Bankshall Court (2 & 3 Bankshall St).
overall_steps_en: Collect Cheque Return Memo from your bank specifying "Funds Insufficient". | Serve statutory demand notice under Section 138(b) via registered post within 30 days. | Wait 15 days for drawer to make payment; cause of action arises on 16th day. | File criminal complaint under Section 142 before Judicial Magistrate within 30 days.

title_en: Cyber UPI / Net-Banking Fraud Account Freezing
relevant_act: Sec 503, BNSS, 2023 & Information Tech Act
authority_forum_en: Cyber Crime Police Station (1930) / CJM Court
timeframe_en: Golden Hour (2 to 24 hours for freezing); 30 days for release
overall_steps_en: Call National Cyber Helpline 1930 immediately to trigger backend bank beneficiary freeze. | Lodge formal complaint on https://cybercrime.gov.in and secure acknowledgment number. | Obtain police investigation verification report identifying layer-1/layer-2 accounts. | File petition under Section 503 BNSS before Magistrate to release unencumbered funds.

title_en: Order XXXVII Fast-Track Summary Debt Suit
relevant_act: Order XXXVII Rules 1, 2 & 3, CPC, 1908
authority_forum_en: City Civil Court (Kolkata) / Commercial Court Rajarhat (Districts)
rural_authority_en: Designated Commercial Court at Rajarhat / District Civil Courts
rural_steps_en: Collate written contract, bills of exchange, or acknowledged GST invoices in district. | File Summary Suit under Order XXXVII CPC before Designated Commercial Court at Rajarhat / Alipore. | Court serves Form 4 summons; defendant must enter appearance within 10 days. | If leave to defend is refused, judge immediately decrees full amount with interest.
kolkata_authority_en: City Civil Court at Calcutta / High Court Commercial Division
kolkata_steps_en: Compile accepted commercial invoices and delivery challans originating within Kolkata. | File Order XXXVII Summary Suit before City Civil Court or High Court Commercial Division. | Court issues special summary summons; defendant must deposit security to contest. | Court enters final money decree and issues execution precept against bank accounts.
overall_steps_en: Collate written contract, bills of exchange, promissory notes, or acknowledged invoices. | File Summary Suit under Order XXXVII CPC in jurisdictional Commercial/Civil Court. | Court serves Form 4 summons; defendant must enter appearance within 10 days. | If defendant fails to secure leave to defend, judge immediately decrees full amount with interest.

title_en: Protection Against Unlicensed Private Moneylenders
relevant_act: Bengal Money-Lenders Act, 1940 & BNS, 2023
rural_authority_en: Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) / District Magistrate & Local Police
rural_steps_en: Verify whether moneylender holds active license from District Magistrate under Bengal Money-Lenders Act. | Submit petition before SDO citing extortionate compounding interest and intimidation. | SDO directs local police station to halt recovery agent harassment and register FIR under Section 308 BNS. | Civil Court invokes Section 33 to scale down interest to statutory non-usurious ceilings.
kolkata_authority_en: Kolkata Collectorate & Kolkata Police (Anti-Rowdy Section, Lalbazar)
kolkata_steps_en: Verify moneylending registration with Collector of Stamp Revenue / Kolkata Collectorate. | Lodge complaint at local police station and escalate to Anti-Rowdy Section, Lalbazar. | Lalbazar detective department initiates action against unregistered lending syndicates. | Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (Bankshall) orders seizure of blank signed cheques held by lender.
overall_steps_en: Verify whether lender holds an active Moneylending License from the District Magistrate. | Demand inspection of statutory accounts register under Bengal Money-Lenders Act. | If harassed by recovery agents, lodge criminal complaint for extortion under Section 308 BNS. | In civil suits, plead Section 33 to reopen accounts and reduce interest to statutory caps.

title_en: Pre-Institution Commercial Mediation via DLSA
relevant_act: Sec 12A, Commercial Courts Act, 2015
authority_forum_en: DLSA Mediation Cell (District / City Civil Kolkata)
rural_authority_en: District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) in District Courts
rural_steps_en: Submit Form-1 application before Member Secretary, District DLSA. | DLSA issues mediation notice to opposite party giving 10 days to appear. | Attend conciliation sessions in District Court mediation room. | If party defaults, DLSA issues Non-Starter Report enabling filing at Rajarhat Commercial Court.
kolkata_authority_en: City Civil Court Mediation Centre / High Court Mediation Cell
kolkata_steps_en: File Section 12A pre-institution mediation at City Civil Court Mediation Centre. | Judicial mediators conduct confidential caucus sessions between business heads. | If settled, executed settlement operates as a binding court decree under Section 12A(4). | If mediation fails, obtain Non-Starter Certificate to file suit at City Civil / High Court.
overall_steps_en: Submit Form-1 application for pre-institution mediation before Member Secretary, DLSA. | DLSA issues mediation notice to opposite party giving 10 days to appear. | Attend joint conciliation sessions; if resolved, formal Settlement Agreement is executed. | If party fails to appear, DLSA issues Non-Starter Report enabling direct court filing.

title_en: Interim Compensation Deposit of 20% in Cheque Trials
relevant_act: Sec 143A, Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
overall_steps_en: After accused enters plea of not guilty under Section 251 CrPC/BNSS, file Section 143A application. | Demonstrate prima facie legally enforceable debt through invoices and bank return memos. | Magistrate orders accused to deposit up to 20% of cheque value within 60 days. | If accused defaults, recover sum as land revenue fine under Section 421 CrPC/Sec 460 BNSS.

title_en: Stop Payment & Account Closed Cheque Liability
relevant_act: Sec 138 & 139, Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
overall_steps_en: Obtain Bank Memo showing reason "Payment Stopped by Drawer" or "Account Closed". | Serve statutory demand notice citing Supreme Court rulings confirming Section 138 applicability. | Drawer must establish existence of genuine pre-existing dispute to escape liability. | Magistrate proceeds with trial; statutory presumption of liability under Section 139 applies.

title_en: MSME Delayed Payment Recovery & Compound Interest
relevant_act: Sec 18 & 19, MSMED Act, 2006
authority_forum_en: West Bengal Micro & Small Enterprises Facilitation Council (MSEFC)
overall_steps_en: Verify enterprise holds valid Udyam Registration Certificate prior to supply date. | File online case on MSME Samadhaan portal (https://samadhaan.msme.gov.in/). | Council issues conciliation notice; if unsettled, matter auto-converts to arbitration. | Council passes arbitral award for principal plus monthly compound interest at 3x RBI rate.

title_en: Unpaid Wages, Gratuity & Retrenchment Dues
relevant_act: Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 / Payment of Wages Act
authority_forum_en: Controlling Authority under Payment of Gratuity Act / Labour Court
overall_steps_en: Submit Form-I application to employer claiming gratuity within 30 days of retirement/exit. | If employer defaults for 30 days, file Form-N petition before Controlling Authority (Labour Dept). | Controlling Authority conducts inquiry, determines dues, and directs payment with 10% interest. | Upon default, Collector issues recovery certificate to seize company bank accounts.

title_en: Investor Refund in Ponzi / Non-Banking Scams
relevant_act: WB Protection of Interest of Depositors (In Financial Establishments) Act
authority_forum_en: Designated Special Court / Competent Authority (Finance Dept)
overall_steps_en: Collect original bond certificates, deposit receipts, and agent passbooks. | Submit claim petition before Competent Authority appointed under the State Depositors Act. | Special Court ratifies attachment of company real estate, hotel resorts, and luxury vehicles. | Assets auctioned via public tender; pro-rata refunds distributed directly into verified accounts.

title_en: Execution of Money Decree via Bank Garnishee Order
relevant_act: Order XXI Rules 46 & 46A–46I, CPC, 1908
overall_steps_en: File Execution Petition under Order XXI Rule 11 CPC with certified money decree. | Identify judgment debtor bank branches and account numbers through discovery inquiries. | Move application under Order XXI Rule 46A CPC for issuance of a Garnishee Notice. | Court orders bank manager to debit funds from debtor balance and transmit draft to court.

title_en: Recovery of Advance Token Money for Failed Deals
relevant_act: Sec 64 & 65, Indian Contract Act, 1872
overall_steps_en: Compile bank payment receipts, token money vouchers, and draft sale agreements. | Serve statutory demand notice citing Section 65 Contract Act (obligation to restore advantage). | File Summary Suit under Order XXXVII CPC or ordinary Money Suit claiming 12% interest. | Obtain decree directing seller to refund full token money plus legal costs.

title_en: Promissory Note (Handnote / Dasto-khat) Debt Suit
relevant_act: Sec 4 & 79 NI Act r/w Order XXXVII CPC
overall_steps_en: Verify promissory note bears requisite revenue stamps and signature across stamps. | Confirm claim is within 3 years of execution date under Article 35 Limitation Act. | Serve statutory advocate notice demanding repayment within 15 days. | File Summary Suit under Order XXXVII CPC; Section 118 presumption mandates recovery.

title_en: Extortion by Digital Loan Apps & Recovery Agents
relevant_act: RBI Digital Lending Guidelines 2022 & BNS, 2023
authority_forum_en: Cyber Police Station (1930) / RBI Sachet Portal
overall_steps_en: Preserve screenshots of threatening WhatsApp chats, morphed photos, and extortion calls. | File immediate complaint on Cyber Crime Portal (1930) under Sections 308 & 351 BNS. | Report illegal app on RBI Sachet portal (https://sachet.rbi.org.in/) for server takedown. | Cyber Police directs Google Play/Apple Store to remove app and freezes mule accounts.

title_en: Demand Notice for Corporate Debt under IBC
relevant_act: Sec 8 & 9, Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code, 2016
authority_forum_en: National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT, Kolkata Bench)
overall_steps_en: Verify operational debt exceeds statutory ₹1 Crore default threshold. | Serve statutory 10-day Demand Notice in Form-3 or Form-4 with invoices attached. | Wait 10 days; if debtor fails to prove genuine pre-existing dispute, cause arises. | File Section 9 Insolvency Petition before NCLT Kolkata Bench to appoint IRP.

title_en: Recovery of Commercial Security Deposits from Mall Owners
relevant_act: Sec 73 & 74, Contract Act r/w Order XXXVII CPC
overall_steps_en: Collate lease agreement, key handover receipt, and formal exit inspection report. | Serve statutory demand notice giving 15 days to refund deposit with 18% commercial interest. | File Pre-Institution Mediation petition under Section 12A Commercial Courts Act via DLSA. | If mediation fails, institute Order XXXVII CPC Summary Suit and attach mall rental receivables.

title_en: NACH & Electronic ECS Mandate Dishonour Prosecution
relevant_act: Sec 25, Payment & Settlement Systems Act, 2007 (PSSA)
overall_steps_en: Retrieve statutory electronic return memo from clearing house citing "Insufficient Funds". | Serve statutory demand notice within 30 days of receiving memo, demanding payment in 15 days. | If unpaid, file criminal complaint under Section 25 PSSA before Magistrate within 30 days. | Magistrate issues summons; conviction entails imprisonment up to 2 years or double fine.

title_en: Recovery of Lost Funds in Phishing & SIM Swap Scams
relevant_act: Sec 43A, Information Technology Act, 2000 r/w RBI Circulars
authority_forum_en: State IT Secretary (Adjudicating Officer) / Banking Ombudsman
overall_steps_en: Lodge emergency cyber complaint on 1930 and freeze beneficiary bank account. | Obtain written confirmation from telecom proving unauthorized SIM re-issuance without biometric KYC. | File complaint before State IT Secretary (Adjudicating Officer under Sec 46 IT Act). | Secure award directing full restoration of drained funds plus compensation for data breach.

title_en: Pre-Packaged Insolvency for Stressed MSME Vendors
relevant_act: Chapter III-A, Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code, 2016
authority_forum_en: National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT, Kolkata Bench)
overall_steps_en: Pass special board resolution and secure 66% financial creditor approval for PPIRP scheme. | Prepare base resolution plan with registered insolvency professional keeping business operating. | File Form-1 before NCLT Kolkata Bench for admission and immediate debt moratorium. | NCLT approves plan within 30 days, binding all creditors and wiping out legacy unserviced debt.

title_en: Execution of Foreign Court Money Decrees in India
relevant_act: Sec 44A & 13, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copy of foreign decree and non-satisfaction certificate from foreign court. | Verify foreign country is notified as a "reciprocating territory" under Section 44A CPC. | File Execution Petition under Order XXI CPC directly before District Judge where debtor holds assets. | Obtain orders for attachment and public auction of Indian immovable assets without fresh trial.

title_en: Attachment of Salary for Money Decree Execution
relevant_act: Sec 60(1)(i) & Order XXI Rule 48, CPC, 1908
overall_steps_en: File execution petition detailing debtor employer address and net monthly salary. | Pray for attachment order under Order XXI Rule 48 CPC up to non-exempt limit (one-third salary). | Court serves a formal Salary Garnishee precept directly on employer disbursing officer. | Employer automatically deducts installment every month and deposits directly into court treasury.

title_en: Detention of Wilful Debt Defaulters in Civil Prison
relevant_act: Sec 51 r/w Order XXI Rules 37–40, CPC, 1908
overall_steps_en: File application under Order XXI Rule 37 CPC supported by affidavit showing debtor has means to pay. | Court issues show-cause notice directing judgment debtor to appear and explain why they should not be jailed. | If debtor absconds or refuses compliance, court issues warrant of civil arrest. | Upon inquiry, if wilful evasion is established, judge commits debtor to civil prison up to 90 days.

title_en: Unpaid Dues of Civil, Electrical & Construction Contractors
relevant_act: Indian Contract Act, 1872 & MSMED Act, 2006
authority_forum_en: Commercial Court / West Bengal MSME Council
overall_steps_en: Compile verified work orders, site measurement sheets signed by site engineers, and approved RA bills. | Issue 15-day statutory demand letter demanding payment and release of defect liability guarantees. | If registered under Udyam, file reference on MSME Samadhaan portal claiming 3x RBI interest. | If not MSME, institute Commercial Suit praying for summary judgment under Order XIII-A CPC.

title_en: Recovery of Unpaid Consultant & Freelance Professional Fees
relevant_act: Order XXXVII, CPC, 1908 r/w Indian Contract Act
authority_forum_en: Civil Summary Court / Small Causes Court
overall_steps_en: Organize signed work contracts, written email acceptance of deliverables, and GST invoices. | Serve final legal demand notice giving 15 days to clear unpaid professional consultancy invoices. | File Order XXXVII CPC Summary Suit; defendant must apply for leave to defend in 10 days. | If leave to defend is refused or not filed, judge immediately enters judgment for the debt.

title_en: Urgent Appeal Against SARFAESI Bank Property Auction
relevant_act: Sec 17, SARFAESI Act, 2002
timeframe_en: Mandatory filing within 45 days of auction notice
overall_steps_en: Receive bank Section 13(4) physical possession or e-auction notice published in newspapers. | Hire approved valuer to prepare independent valuation showing bank set a deflated reserve price. | File Securitisation Application (SA) under Section 17 before DRT Kolkata within 45 days. | Obtain ad-interim stay on auction bids subject to depositing token percentage (10%–20%) with bank.

title_en: Liability & Discharge of Personal Guarantors for Corporate Loans
relevant_act: Sec 128–141, Indian Contract Act, 1872 r/w Part III, IBC
overall_steps_en: Examine loan modification history between bank and debtor to detect variance of contract terms. | Cite Section 133 Contract Act: variance made without guarantor consent discharges guarantor. | Reply to bank demand notice asserting statutory discharge and release of personal collateral. | If bank invokes insolvency under Section 95 IBC, file objection before NCLT establishing discharge.

title_en: Recovery of Friendly Loans Without Formal Written Contract
relevant_act: Sec 63, BSA, 2023 r/w Contract Act (Implied Contracts)
overall_steps_en: Extract certified bank statements showing NEFT, IMPS, or UPI transfers with transaction IDs. | Collate WhatsApp, SMS, or audio recordings where borrower acknowledges debt and promises return. | Serve formal Advocate Legal Notice demanding repayment within 15 days, cementing default. | File ordinary Money Suit before Civil Judge attaching bank records as evidence under Section 63 BSA.

title_en: Siphoning of Partnership Funds & Action for Accounts
relevant_act: Sec 48 & 69, Indian Partnership Act, 1932
overall_steps_en: Produce registered Partnership Deed and bank records revealing unauthorized transfers. | Serve formal dissolution and rendering of accounts notice under Section 43 Partnership Act. | File Suit for Dissolution of Partnership and Taking Accounts before Civil Judge (Senior Division). | Move urgent application under Order XXXIX CPC for injunction freezing all firm bank operations.

title_en: Refund of Advance Paid to Unregistered Plot Developers
relevant_act: Sec 65, Indian Contract Act r/w Consumer Protection Act
overall_steps_en: Verify from municipal planning authority and Banglarbhumi that plot project lacks layout nod. | Issue legal notice rescinding booking on grounds of misrepresentation and demanding full refund. | File complaint on e-Jagriti portal alleging unfair trade practices and claiming 12% interest. | Obtain recovery certificate executed through District Collector via Bengal PDR Act.

title_en: Challenge to Compound & Usurious Interest by Banks
relevant_act: Usurious Loans Act, 1918 r/w RBI Fair Practices Code
overall_steps_en: Conduct audit of loan account statement to isolate capitalization of penal interest. | Submit formal representation to bank citing RBI directives barring charging penal interest on penal interest. | File complaint before RBI Integrated Ombudsman for rectification of loan ledger. | If bank initiates court recovery, plead Section 3 Usurious Loans Act empowering judges to reopen contracts.

title_en: Appeal Before Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal (DRAT)
relevant_act: Sec 18, SARFAESI Act, 2002
timeframe_en: Mandatory appeal within 30 days of DRT order
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copies of DRT order rejecting stay against bank auction. | Draft appeal memo accompanied by Interim Application for Waiver of Pre-Deposit citing insolvency. | File statutory appeal before Registrar, DRAT Kolkata (serving Eastern India). | Argue waiver petition; Chairperson has statutory discretion to reduce pre-deposit down to 25%.

title_en: Injunction Against Encashment of Bank Guarantees
relevant_act: Specific Relief Act, 1963 r/w Commercial Contract Precedents
overall_steps_en: Establish strict legal grounds: "egregious fraud known to bank" or "irretrievable injustice". | Serve immediate written intimation to issuing bank putting them on notice of fraudulent invocation. | Move emergency Section 9 arbitration petition or commercial injunction suit before Commercial Judge. | Obtain injunction order commanding bank to withhold encashment pending final arbitration.

title_en: Recovery of Debts from Deceased Borrower’s Estate
relevant_act: Sec 52, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
overall_steps_en: File an application under Section 50 CPC to bring surviving legal heirs onto the execution record. | File asset disclosure petition requiring heirs to declare all properties inherited from deceased. | Issue attachment orders strictly against inherited estate properties under Section 52 CPC. | Auction attached assets; legal heirs bear zero personal liability beyond value of inherited assets.

title_en: Attachment of Property Before Judgment to Stop Asset Stripping
relevant_act: Order XXXVIII Rules 5–12, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
authority_forum_en: Civil Trial Court hearing Money Suit
overall_steps_en: Produce credible evidence (affidavits, broker ads) proving defendant is attempting to liquidate assets. | File urgent petition under Order XXXVIII Rule 5 CPC directing defendant to furnish security. | Court issues conditional attachment notice calling upon defendant to deposit security in 7 days. | If defendant defaults, court attaches real estate, communicating freeze directly to Sub-Registrar.

title_en: Cheque Bounce Defense: Cheque Given as Security / Stolen
relevant_act: Sec 138 & 139, Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
timeframe_en: Raised in response to notice and cross-examination
overall_steps_en: Reply to 30-day notice immediately stating cheque was given as security without legally enforceable debt. | Produce commercial contract explicitly mentioning serial numbers of cheques deposited as security. | Cross-examine complainant to expose lack of consideration or that underlying debt was already paid. | Court acquits accused, holding statutory presumption under Section 139 stands rebutted.

title_en: High Court Quashing of Malicious Cheque Cases
relevant_act: Sec 528, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
overall_steps_en: Examine complaint petition for jurisdictional defects: missing postal receipts or time-barred filing. | File Criminal Revision / Quashing Petition under Section 528 BNSS before High Court Single Bench. | Move application for stay of trial court proceedings and exemption from personal physical appearance. | High Court quashes complaint, holding continuation constitutes an abuse of judicial process.

title_en: Education Loan Recovery & One-Time Settlement (OTS)
relevant_act: IBA Model Educational Loan Scheme & Legal Services Authorities Act
overall_steps_en: Obtain loan ledger statement showing original principal disbursement and accumulated interest. | Submit OTS application to Bank Nodal Officer proving unemployment or genuine financial hardship. | Request referral of the loan account to the forthcoming National Lok Adalat organized by DLSA. | Execute compromised Lok Adalat settlement paying reduced principal; secure No-Dues Certificate (NOC).

title_en: Repossession Defense in Commercial Vehicle Loans
relevant_act: RBI Guidelines on Recovery Agents r/w ICICI Bank v. Shanti Devi (SC)
timeframe_en: Immediate police complaint; 30 days consumer notice
overall_steps_en: Lodge immediate FIR for extortion and highway robbery under Section 308 BNS if seized forcibly. | File urgent complaint before District Consumer Commission alleging violation of RBI recovery norms. | Secure order directing financier to return seized vehicle and restraining repossession without court. | Court levies punitive compensation on NBFC for engaging musclemen and violating guidelines.

title_en: Insolvency of Proprietary Concerns & Personal Firms
relevant_act: Sec 94 & 95, Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code, 2016
overall_steps_en: Prepare audited statement of affairs detailing liabilities, creditor charges, and personal assets. | Submit application under Section 94 IBC before jurisdictional DRT for initiating personal insolvency. | Upon filing, automatic interim moratorium commences, halting ongoing creditor lawsuits and seizures. | DRT appoints Resolution Professional to negotiate formal debt repayment plan spanning up to 3 years.

title_en: Recovery of Demurrage, Port & Ocean Shipping Freight
relevant_act: Major Port Trusts Act r/w Admiralty (Jurisdiction & Settlement) Act, 2017
authority_forum_en: High Court at Calcutta (Admiralty Jurisdiction) / Commercial Court
overall_steps_en: Obtain bill of lading, customs out-of-charge orders, and shipping line container detention bills. | Serve demand notice challenging excessive demurrage during customs hold periods outside importer control. | File Commercial Suit or Admiralty Petition before High Court at Calcutta for release of containers. | Obtain interim order releasing containers against deposit of reasonable security, preventing cargo deterioration.

title_en: Defense Against Forged Signature on Handnotes
relevant_act: Sec 45, Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (BSA)
timeframe_en: Raised during evidence stage; 3 to 6 months CFSL
overall_steps_en: Inspect original disputed promissory note in court custody; document ink and stroke discrepancies. | File application under Section 45 BSA and Order XXVI Rule 10A CPC for Handwriting Expert appointment. | Provide contemporaneous admitted specimen signatures (from banks/passports) in presence of judge. | CFSL submits expert report confirming forgery, resulting in dismissal of false recovery suit.

title_en: Suit Against State for Overpaid Stamp Duty & Tax Refunds
relevant_act: Sec 72, Indian Contract Act r/w Article 265, Constitution
overall_steps_en: Produce treasury challans and government rectification orders proving tax was levied erroneously. | Submit formal administrative refund requisition to Collector of Stamp Revenue or Municipal Commissioner. | If refund is delayed beyond 90 days, serve 60-day statutory notice under Section 80 CPC on the State. | File Civil Suit for Recovery of Money Paid Under Mistake, securing decree with 6% interest.

title_en: Suit for Dissolution of Partnership & Rendering of Accounts
relevant_act: Sec 44, Partnership Act, 1932 & Order XX Rule 15 CPC
overall_steps_en: Produce registered Partnership Deed and bank records revealing unauthorized transfers. | Serve formal dissolution and rendering of accounts notice under Section 43 Partnership Act. | File Suit for Dissolution of Partnership and Taking Accounts before Civil Judge (Senior Division). | Move urgent application under Order XXXIX CPC for injunction freezing all firm bank operations.

title_en: Whistleblower & Fraud Recovery Petitions Before SFIO
relevant_act: Sec 212 & 447, Companies Act, 2013
overall_steps_en: Compile financial records, ROC filings, and transaction schedules proving fraud over ₹1 Crore. | Submit whistleblower complaint to Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) under Section 212. | Central Government assigns investigation to Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO). | SFIO arrests delinquent directors, attaches private properties, and files claw-back petition in NCLT.

title_en: Defamation & Correction of Damaged CIBIL / Credit Reports
relevant_act: Credit Information Companies (Regulation) Act, 2005 (CICRA)
overall_steps_en: Download official credit report highlighting erroneous overdue entries on settled loans. | Raise online dispute on CIBIL Dispute Resolution Portal and serve notice on reporting bank. | If uncorrected in 30 days, lodge complaint with RBI Banking Ombudsman under CICRA regulations. | Bank and CIBIL ordered to purge default record, restore credit rating, and pay ₹100/day delay penalty.

title_en: Share Demat Fraud & Recovery from Unauthorized Stock Brokers
relevant_act: SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regs r/w SCORES Portal
authority_forum_en: SEBI SCORES / Investor Grievance Cell (NSE / BSE)
