overall_steps_en: Extract monthly CDSL/NSDL Demat transaction statements displaying unauthorized debit transfers. | Lodge immediate complaint on SEBI SCORES 2.0 portal (https://scores.sebi.gov.in/) attaching trading logs. | If unresolved in 21 days, dispute auto-escalates to Exchange Investor Grievance Redressal Committee. | Exchange committee freezes broker clearing deposits and compensates investor from Protection Fund.

title_en: Execution of Commercial Arbitral Award as Civil Decree
relevant_act: Sec 36, Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1996
overall_steps_en: Wait for expiry of mandatory 90-day appeal window under Section 34 of Arbitration Act. | File Execution Petition under Section 36 in Commercial Court where judgment debtor has assets. | Arbitral award is enforced under Code of Civil Procedure in identical manner to a civil money decree. | Judge issues attachment warrants over debtor real estate and directs banks to remit funds.

title_en: Insurance Agents Suing for Unlawfully Withheld Commissions
relevant_act: IRDAI (Insurance Agents) Regulations, 2016 r/w Contract Act
overall_steps_en: Review agency agreement and prove compliance with 5-year/10-year service threshold for renewal rights. | Serve demand notice on insurance company zonal manager demanding release of accrued renewal ledger. | File formal regulatory complaint before IRDAI Grievance Officer for breach of Agent Protection Norms. | If unpaid, file Civil Summary Suit before Civil Judge (Senior Division) for liquidated commission dues.

title_en: Third-Party Garnishee Notices to Recover Judgment Debt
relevant_act: Order XXI Rules 46A–46I, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
overall_steps_en: Identify third parties (e.g. corporate clients, tenants) who owe liquidated money to judgment debtor. | File application under Order XXI Rule 46A CPC praying for issuance of a Garnishee Notice. | Court serves notice directing third party to appear and deposit owed amount into court. | If third party defaults or pays debtor secretly, court issues execution directly against third party.

title_en: Bank Non-Performing Asset (NPA) Lok Adalat Compromise
relevant_act: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 r/w RBI NPA Settlement Norms
overall_steps_en: Receive pre-litigation Lok Adalat summons or request bank to place NPA file before upcoming Lok Adalat. | Prepare upfront settlement offer based on borrower liquidatable net worth and genuine hardship proof. | Appear before Lok Adalat Bench comprising a Judicial Officer and senior legal aid advocate. | Execute compromised settlement award; award is final, non-appealable, and entitles borrower to 100% court fee refund.

title_en: Monthly Maintenance for Wife & Children (Sec 144 BNSS)
relevant_act: Sec 144, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
overall_steps_en: File Maintenance Application under Section 144 BNSS before jurisdictional Family Court. | File mandatory Affidavit of Assets & Liabilities per Supreme Court Rajnesh v. Neha format. | Secure interim maintenance order within 60 days of summons service for daily sustenance. | Magistrate passes final monthly maintenance order; non-payment attracts distress arrest warrants.

title_en: Senior Citizen Maintenance & Abusive Child Eviction
relevant_act: Sec 5 & 23, Senior Citizens Act, 2007
rural_authority_en: Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) Maintenance Tribunal
rural_steps_en: Submit petition under Section 5 before SDO Maintenance Tribunal citing neglect and abuse. | SDO issues summons to adult children within 15 days for conciliation hearing. | Tribunal orders monthly maintenance payments directly into senior citizen bank account. | If child harasses parent, SDO issues eviction order executed by local police.
kolkata_authority_en: Kolkata District Maintenance Tribunal (Kolkata Collectorate at Bankshall St)
kolkata_steps_en: Submit Section 5 petition before District Magistrate / Collector at Bankshall St office. | Collector holds hearing and evaluates maintenance needs against property rental/value. | Tribunal passes order for monthly allowance or cancellation of fraudulent gift deed. | Execution wing at Collectorate enforces eviction if children abuse parents after gift transfer.
overall_steps_en: Submit petition under Section 5 before SDO Maintenance Tribunal citing neglect and abuse. | SDO issues summons to adult children/heirs within 15 days for conciliation hearing. | Tribunal orders monthly maintenance payments directly into senior citizen bank account. | If son/in-laws physically harass, SDO issues administrative eviction order executed by police.

title_en: Domestic Violence Protection & Shared Residence
authority_forum_en: Court of Judicial Magistrate / Protection Officer
timeframe_en: Hearing within 3 days; disposal within 60 days
overall_steps_en: Approach District Protection Officer to prepare Domestic Incident Report (DIR). | File Application under Section 12 PWDVA before Judicial Magistrate praying for urgent orders. | Obtain interim Residence Order (Sec 19) barring husband/in-laws from dispossessing woman. | Magistrate directs Protection Officer and police to break locks and restore woman entry if locked out.

title_en: Mutual Consent Divorce & Settlement (Sec 13B)
relevant_act: Sec 13B, Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
overall_steps_en: Draft joint Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) settling permanent alimony and custody. | File Joint Petition for First Motion under Section 13B(1) HMA before Family Court. | Move waiver application under Amardeep Singh ruling to dispense with the 6-month cooling-off wait. | Appear for Second Motion hearing; judge signs decree dissolving marital ties permanently.

title_en: Child Custody & Interim Visitation Rights
relevant_act: Guardians and Wards Act, 1890
overall_steps_en: File Custody Petition under Section 7 & 25 Guardians and Wards Act before Family Court. | Move urgent interim application under Section 12 for weekend physical visitation and video calls. | Judge interacts privately with minor child in judicial chamber to assess emotional bonding. | Court passes final custody decree, awarding shared parenting or structured visitation schedule.

title_en: Contested Divorce on Mental Cruelty & Desertion
relevant_act: Sec 13(1)(i-a) & (i-b), Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
overall_steps_en: Document instances of cruelty: audio/video proof, medical injury slips, or police complaints. | File Divorce Petition under Section 13(1) before jurisdictional Family Court. | Court refers parties to mandatory mediation under Section 9 Family Courts Act to explore reconciliation. | If mediation fails, trial proceeds; court examines witnesses and passes dissolution decree.

title_en: Restitution of Conjugal Rights (RCR - Sec 9 HMA)
relevant_act: Sec 9, Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
overall_steps_en: Serve formal legal notice expressing affection and requesting spouse return home within 15 days. | File Petition under Section 9 HMA before Family Court establishing lack of reasonable excuse. | Court conducts counseling and conciliation sessions to remove misunderstandings. | If spouse fails to prove justifiable excuse, court passes decree for restitution of conjugal rights.

title_en: Interim Maintenance Pendente Lite & Legal Costs
relevant_act: Sec 24, Hindu Marriage Act (Rajnesh v. Neha)
overall_steps_en: File application under Section 24 HMA in active divorce or RCR proceedings. | Submit statutory Disclosure of Assets & Income Affidavit per Supreme Court mandate. | Demonstrate applicant lacks independent income to maintain themselves and litigate. | Judge orders respondent to pay lump-sum legal costs and monthly maintenance within 60 days.

title_en: Special Marriage Act, 1954 Registration & Notice
relevant_act: Sec 4, 5, 15 & 16, Special Marriage Act, 1954
authority_forum_en: Office of the District Marriage Officer
overall_steps_en: Submit joint Notice of Intended Marriage (Form-II) before District Marriage Officer. | Notice published at office for 30 days inviting statutory legal objections (e.g. unsound mind). | Upon expiry of 30 days without valid objection, couple appears with 3 witnesses. | Marriage solemnized and signed; Marriage Officer issues permanent Special Marriage Certificate.

title_en: Muslim Divorced Women Maintenance & Dower (Mahr)
relevant_act: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1986
authority_forum_en: Court of Judicial Magistrate / Family Court
overall_steps_en: File an application under Section 3 of the 1986 Act before the Judicial Magistrate. | Claim unpaid prompt/deferred dower (Mahr), return of wedding gifts, and maintenance. | Cite Danial Latifi (SC) confirming liability to make reasonable provision for woman lifetime. | Magistrate orders former husband to pay full dower and lump-sum lifetime fair provision in 30 days.

title_en: Distress Warrants & Civil Jail for Unpaid Maintenance
overall_steps_en: Prepare itemized calculation sheet listing accumulated arrears and defaulted court dates. | File an Execution Petition under Section 144(3) BNSS praying for issuance of distress warrant. | Court issues non-bailable Distress Warrant (DW) to police to arrest husband or attach assets. | If husband refuses to liquidate dues, judge commits him to prison for up to 1 month per default.

title_en: Stridhan Jewelry Seizure & Recovery Petition
relevant_act: Sec 19(8) PWDVA r/w Sec 316 BNS (Breach of Trust)
overall_steps_en: Prepare itemized inventory of jewelry, cash, and electronic gifts handed over during marriage. | File an urgent application under Section 19(8) PWDVA praying for restitution of stridhan. | Submit wedding photographs, video logs, and jeweler invoices establishing ownership. | Magistrate directs Protection Officer and police to execute search and return seized gold.

title_en: Maintenance for Major Unmarried Daughters (College Fees)
relevant_act: Sec 20(3), Hindu Adoptions & Maintenance Act, 1956
overall_steps_en: File suit under Section 20(3) of HAMA before Family Court establishing inability to maintain self. | Submit college admission fee structure, semester costs, and professional degree invoices. | Produce father income proofs: ITRs, business company holdings, and bank statements. | Court orders father to deposit college fees directly and sets aside corpus for marriage.

title_en: Paternity Disputes & Forensic DNA Testing Petitions
relevant_act: Sec 114, Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 r/w Supreme Court Norms
authority_forum_en: Family Court / High Court at Calcutta
overall_steps_en: Party denying paternity must establish prima facie evidence of physical non-access during conception. | File an interim application praying for scientific DNA test under Section 114 BSA. | Family Court balances child welfare; tests are never ordered as a fishing or roving inquiry. | Blood samples drawn under court custody and tested at Government CFSL lab for definitive report.

title_en: High Court Police Protection for Runaway Couples
relevant_act: Article 226, Constitution of India (Lata Singh SC)
overall_steps_en: Verify age proof establishing bride is 18+ and groom is 21+ with registered marriage proof. | File emergency Writ Petition (Art 226) before High Court Bench citing life threats. | Court interacts with couple to confirm free consent and absence of coercion or abduction. | High Court directs Superintendent of Police (SP) to provide 24/7 protection.

title_en: Annulment of Marriage on Fraud, Impotency & Concealment
relevant_act: Sec 12, Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
timeframe_en: Mandatory filing within 1 year of discovering fraud
overall_steps_en: Collate medical records, prior marriage certificates, or psychiatric diagnoses establishing fraud. | File petition for Annulment of Voidable Marriage under Section 12 HMA within 1 year. | Prove that petitioner did not voluntarily cohabit after discovering the fraud. | Family Court passes Decree of Nullity, declaring marriage void as if it never occurred.

title_en: Nullity of Void Marriages (Bigamy & Sapinda Relations)
relevant_act: Sec 11 & Sec 5(i), (iv), (v), Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
overall_steps_en: Collect subsistence proof of spouse previous living partner (registered marriage certificate and voter ID). | File Petition for Declaration of Nullity under Section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act. | Prove that the marriage violated Section 5(i) (spouse living) or Section 5(v) (sapinda lineage). | Court passes Decree of Nullity confirming the marriage was legally non-existent from inception.

title_en: Injunction Against Forced Child Marriage
relevant_act: Sec 13, Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 (PCMA)
authority_forum_en: Judicial Magistrate Court / Child Welfare Committee (CWC)
overall_steps_en: Minor, relative, or NGO lodges urgent petition before Judicial Magistrate or Childline (1098). | Produce birth certificate or school admission register proving girl is under 18 or boy under 21. | Magistrate issues ex-parte Injunction Order under Section 13 PCMA prohibiting ceremony. | Local police and Child Welfare Officers halt ceremony and place child under safe foster care.

title_en: High Court Quashing of Malicious 498A Dowry FIRs
relevant_act: Sec 528 BNSS r/w Arnesh Kumar & Preeti Gupta (SC)
overall_steps_en: Collect residence records (leases, utility bills, out-of-state jobs) proving separate living. | File Criminal Miscellaneous Quashing Petition under Section 528 BNSS before High Court. | Highlight vague, omnibus allegations without specific dates, times, or overt physical acts. | High Court stays arrest, exempts personal trial appearance, and quashes criminal proceedings.

title_en: Protection of Shared Household Rights for Daughters-in-Law
relevant_act: Sec 17 & 19, PWDVA r/w Satish Chander Ahuja (SC)
timeframe_en: Hearing within 3 days; order in 15 days
overall_steps_en: Document physical lock-outs, threats of dispossession, or attempts to remove personal belongings. | File urgent petition under Section 12 PWDVA before Judicial Magistrate. | Move interim application under Section 19(1) for a mandatory Residence Order protecting stay. | Magistrate directs Protection Officer and police to break locks and restore woman entry if locked out.

title_en: Mandatory Income & Asset Disclosure Affidavits in Alimony
relevant_act: Sec 24, Hindu Marriage Act (Rajnesh v. Neha SC)
overall_steps_en: File application under Section 24 HMA in active divorce or RCR proceedings. | Submit statutory Disclosure of Assets & Income Affidavit per Supreme Court mandate. | Demonstrate applicant lacks independent income to maintain themselves and litigate. | Judge orders respondent to pay lump-sum legal costs and monthly maintenance within 60 days.

title_en: International Child Custody Battles & NRI Parent Disputes
relevant_act: Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 r/w Nithya Anand Raghavan (SC)
authority_forum_en: High Court at Calcutta (Writ of Habeas Corpus) / Family Court
overall_steps_en: Foreign parent files Writ of Habeas Corpus under Article 226 before High Court at Calcutta. | High Court prioritizes primary legal doctrine of "welfare of the child" over foreign court decrees. | Judge interacts privately with minor child in judicial chamber to ascertain schooling stability. | High Court decides whether to order repatriation or retain Indian custody with digital visitations.

title_en: Multi-Faith Civil Matrimonial Dissolution & Rights
relevant_act: Sec 27 & 36–38, Special Marriage Act, 1954 (SMA)
overall_steps_en: Produce Special Marriage Certificate proving marriage was registered under secular civil framework. | Exclude personal religious laws; all ancillary matrimonial claims must strictly follow civil statutes. | File petition for divorce or judicial separation under Section 27 of Special Marriage Act. | Family Court applies secular principles to divide assets and calculate maintenance equally.

title_en: Legal Parentage & Custody Rights in Commercial Surrogacy
relevant_act: Surrogacy (Regulation) Act, 2021 & ART Act, 2021
authority_forum_en: District Medical Board / Judicial Magistrate Court
timeframe_en: Parentage order within 15 days of birth
overall_steps_en: Obtain Eligibility Certificate from District Medical Board confirming medical need for surrogacy. | Execute statutory surrogacy agreement and secure mandatory 3-year health insurance for surrogate. | Upon delivery, clinic immediately registers birth listing commissioning parents as father/mother. | Apply to Magistrate Court for parentage order barring surrogate from claiming parental custody.

title_en: Inter-Country Adoption & CARA Clearance Protocols
relevant_act: Juvenile Justice (Care & Protection) Act, 2015 & Adoption Regulations
overall_steps_en: Register online on centralized CARA portal (CARINGS) and submit Home Study Report (HSR). | Match with eligible legally free child and execute physical child acceptance dossier within 30 days. | Specialized Adoption Agency (SAA) files formal adoption petition before District Magistrate (DM). | DM issues final non-appealable Adoption Order; CARA issues mandatory NOC for child passport.

title_en: Parental Alienation Syndrome (PAS) & Custody Modification
relevant_act: Sec 7, 10 & 25, Guardians and Wards Act, 1890
overall_steps_en: Document repeated violations of visitation orders, recorded phone calls, and missed weekend access. | File an application under Section 25 GWA for modification of custody, alleging Parental Alienation. | Move for independent psychiatric evaluation of the child by a specialized clinical child psychologist. | Court alters custody or grants exclusive overnight visitation to restore natural emotional bonding.

title_en: Setting Aside Ex-Parte Divorce Decrees
relevant_act: Order IX Rule 13, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
timeframe_en: Within 30 days of knowledge of decree
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copy of the ex-parte divorce judgment and process server summons return report. | Prove that summons was sent to a bogus address where the applicant never resided. | File petition under Order IX Rule 13 CPC within 30 days of discovering the fraudulent decree. | Family Court sets aside the ex-parte divorce decree and restores the matrimonial suit for fresh trial.

title_en: Enhancement or Reduction of Monthly Maintenance
relevant_act: Sec 144(5), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
overall_steps_en: Collect evidence of changed circumstances: child admission fees, medical receipts, or termination letters. | File petition for alteration of maintenance under Section 144(5) BNSS before the Family Court. | Submit updated Affidavit of Assets & Liabilities highlighting current living expenses and income disparity. | Magistrate recalculates subsistence needs and passes revised monthly maintenance order.

title_en: Lifelong Maintenance for Disabled Adult Offspring
relevant_act: Sec 144(1)(c), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
overall_steps_en: Secure government disability certificate (UDID) confirming permanent physical or mental infirmity. | File maintenance petition under Section 144(1)(c) BNSS establishing inability to earn an independent living. | Formulate itemized schedule of lifelong monthly therapy, caregiver, and special medical expenses. | Court decrees lifelong monthly allowance and directs creation of a fixed deposit corpus for the child.

title_en: Declaration of Presumption of Death for Missing Spouse
relevant_act: Sec 111, Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 r/w Sec 108 Evidence Act
overall_steps_en: Produce original police General Diary (GD) and missing complaint filed at least 7 years prior. | Publish statutory public notice in widely circulated local newspapers calling for information. | File Declaratory Suit under Section 34 Specific Relief Act invoking Section 111 BSA. | Civil Judge issues decree declaring legal presumption of death, enabling pension settlement and remarriage.

title_en: Parsi Matrimonial Dissolution & Alimony
relevant_act: Sec 30, 31 & 32, Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act, 1936
authority_forum_en: Special Parsi Matrimonial Court (High Court at Calcutta)
overall_steps_en: Secure Parsi Marriage Certificate registered under Section 6 of the 1936 Act. | File divorce plaint before the Special Parsi Matrimonial Court at High Court at Calcutta. | High Court summons five registered Parsi delegates from the community roster to sit with judge. | Delegates adjudicate facts of desertion or cruelty; presiding judge enters dissolution decree and alimony.

title_en: Christian Matrimonial Dissolution & Alimony (Divorce Act)
relevant_act: Sec 10 & 10A, Indian Divorce Act, 1869
overall_steps_en: Produce Church Marriage Certificate and proof of 2 years continuous separate living for Section 10A. | File petition for dissolution before District Judge; for contested cases under Section 10, prove cruelty. | Court conducts mandatory counseling sessions exploring reconciliation. | District Judge enters final decree of dissolution and determines monthly or lump-sum alimony.

title_en: Muslim Dissolution of Marriage (Khula, Faskh & Mubarat)
relevant_act: Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act, 1939 r/w Shayara Bano SC
overall_steps_en: Serve formal communication expressing terms of Khula or reasons for seeking dissolution. | File suit under Section 2 of the 1939 Act before Family Court on grounds of cruelty or 2-year non-maintenance. | Family Court examines witnesses and assesses genuine irreparable breakdown of marital tie. | Judge passes dissolution decree confirming divorce and protecting woman rights to prompt Mahr.

title_en: Muslim Custody (Hizanat) & Father Guardianship (Wilayat)
relevant_act: Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 r/w Principles of Mohammedan Law
overall_steps_en: Assert mother customary right of Hizanat (male child up to age 7, female child up to puberty). | If father forcibly removes minor child, file petition under Section 25 GWA before Family Court. | Court prioritizes paramount welfare of child over technical personal law assertions. | Judge awards physical custody to mother, directing father to pay monthly maintenance and granting visitation.

title_en: Adoption by Single Male or Female Parents (CARA Norms)
relevant_act: Juvenile Justice Act, 2015 & Central Adoption Regulations
overall_steps_en: Register on CARA portal (carings.wcd.gov.in) selecting category as Single Prospective Adoptive Parent. | Undergo Home Study Report (HSR) by a Specialized Adoption Agency assessing financial and emotional stability. | Comply with age criteria: single parent must be at least 25 years old; single males can adopt only male children. | District Magistrate issues final non-appealable Adoption Order establishing full parental status.

title_en: Judicial Separation vs Divorce (Sec 10 HMA)
relevant_act: Sec 10, Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
overall_steps_en: File petition for Judicial Separation under Section 10 HMA on grounds of cruelty, desertion, or adultery. | Attend mandatory court-ordered reconciliation sessions with Family Court counselors. | Upon establishing grounds, court grants Decree of Judicial Separation suspending cohabitation duties. | If cohabitation is not resumed for 1 year post-decree, either spouse can petition for full divorce.

title_en: Interim Maintenance for Working Wives with Income Disparity
relevant_act: Sec 24 HMA r/w Rajnesh v. Neha (Supreme Court Guidelines)
overall_steps_en: Submit comprehensive salary slip and bank statement demonstrating current personal earning threshold. | File Section 24 HMA petition highlighting husband significantly higher taxable income and corporate perks. | Cite Supreme Court *Rajnesh v. Neha* ruling: mere earning capability or job does not bar maintenance. | Judge orders husband to pay supplemental monthly alimony bridging the lifestyle disparity.

title_en: Permanent Alimony & Gross Sum Capital Settlement
relevant_act: Sec 25, Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
timeframe_en: Decided along with final divorce decree
overall_steps_en: Move application under Section 25 HMA at the stage of passing final divorce decree. | Produce verified valuation of husband business holdings, corporate shareholding, and real estate. | Propose lump-sum capital settlement calculated to yield lifetime living interest without defaults. | Court decrees gross capital sum and creates statutory charge over specific husband immovable properties.

title_en: Recovery of Maintenance Arrears Against NRI Spouses
relevant_act: Sec 144(3) BNSS r/w Passports Act, 1967 & MEA Guidelines
authority_forum_en: Family Court / Judicial Magistrate / High Court
timeframe_en: 60 to 90 working days for LOC execution
overall_steps_en: Compile certified schedule of unpaid maintenance arrears along with foreign employment records. | Obtain Non-Bailable Warrant (NBW) from Judicial Magistrate following repeated defaults. | Move Family Court to direct Ministry of Home Affairs to issue a Look-Out Circular (LOC) at all Indian airports. | Ministry of External Affairs impounds passport under Section 10(3)(h) Passports Act upon arrival.

title_en: Legal Guardianship of Mentally Challenged Adult Family Members
relevant_act: Sec 14, National Trust Act, 1999 & RPwD Act, 2016
authority_forum_en: Local Level Committee (LLC) chaired by District Magistrate
overall_steps_en: Obtain permanent Intellectual Disability Assessment Certificate from a recognized government hospital. | Submit Form-A application before the Local Level Committee (LLC) chaired by the District Magistrate. | LLC reviews family caregiving capability, property holding details, and applicant suitability. | District Magistrate issues official Statutory Legal Guardianship Certificate under National Trust seal.

title_en: Injunction Against Matrimonial Private Spying & Wiretapping
relevant_act: Sec 43 & 66E, IT Act, 2000 r/w Right to Privacy (Puttaswamy SC)
authority_forum_en: Civil Court (Injunction Wing) / High Court at Calcutta
overall_steps_en: Document tangible evidence of illegal surveillance: physical GPS trackers, unauthorized call recordings, or vehicle tracking. | File urgent Civil Injunction Suit asserting fundamental Right to Privacy under Article 21 and the *Puttaswamy* ruling. | Serve formal Cease-and-Desist notice on private investigation agency and spouse. | Court grants injunction restraining third-party surveillance and excludes illegally wiretapped records from evidence.

title_en: Enforcement of Foreign Divorce Decrees in India (Sec 13 CPC)
relevant_act: Sec 13 & 14, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 r/w Y. Narasimha Rao (SC)
authority_forum_en: Family Court / High Court at Calcutta
overall_steps_en: Obtain certified copies of foreign decree and overseas court docket records. | Verify if decree violates Section 13 CPC exceptions (e.g. obtained without natural justice or on non-recognized grounds). | File Civil Declaratory Suit before Family Court praying for declaration that foreign decree is non-conclusive. | Court declares foreign decree null and void in India, restoring matrimonial status and permitting maintenance claims.

title_en: Maintenance of Elderly Parents from Multiple Children Equitably
relevant_act: Sec 5, Maintenance & Welfare of Parents & Senior Citizens Act, 2007
overall_steps_en: Submit Section 5 petition before SDO Maintenance Tribunal impleading all adult working sons and daughters. | Compile schedule of recurring monthly expenditure: heart/diabetes medications, food, and caregiver charges. | Tribunal examines financial capability of each offspring and dismisses excuses shifting sole blame onto one sibling. | SDO issues binding proportionate payment orders directing monthly bank deposits by all children.

title_en: Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP) in Spousal Distress
relevant_act: Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971 (Amended 2021) r/w Supreme Court Norms
authority_forum_en: High Court at Calcutta (Writ Bench) / Medical Board
timeframe_en: Immediate (Within 24 to 48 hours for medical safety)
overall_steps_en: Obtain ultrasound scan confirming gestational age is within statutory limits (up to 24 weeks). | If government hospital refuses citing lack of husband signature, cite Supreme Court ruling confirming woman sole autonomy. | File emergency Writ Petition (Art 226) before High Court vacation/regular bench if administrative delays occur. | High Court orders Medical Board examination and directs government hospital to perform procedure with full privacy.

title_en: Grandparents Visitation Rights Following Parental Demise
relevant_act: Sec 12, Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 (Equitable Welfare Jurisdiction)
timeframe_en: 30 to 60 working days for interim access
overall_steps_en: Produce death certificate of deceased child proving petitioner lineage as natural grandparents. | File application under Section 12 GWA before Family Court asserting emotional bonding and child best interests. | Judge conducts in-camera interaction with grandchild in judicial chambers to ascertain comfort. | Court passes structured visitation schedule granting alternate weekend access and festival holiday hours.

title_en: Attachment of Father Salary for Defaulted Child School Fees
relevant_act: Order XXI Rule 48 CPC r/w Sec 144 BNSS
overall_steps_en: Produce school fee demand notices, fee cards, and bank records demonstrating father non-compliance. | File Execution Application under Order XXI Rule 48 CPC before the Family Court. | Serve formal Salary Garnishee Precept on father employer (DDO / HR Department). | Employer automatically deducts educational dues from monthly pay and deposits directly to school account.

title_en: Recovery of Stolen Dowry & Wedding Gifts (Sec 316 BNS)
relevant_act: Sec 316, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Criminal Breach of Trust)
overall_steps_en: Prepare detailed inventory list of wedding furniture, electronics, and cash gifts signed during marriage. | Serve formal legal notice demanding return of bridal gifts within 15 days. | File criminal complaint under Section 316 BNS (Criminal Breach of Trust) before Judicial Magistrate. | Magistrate orders police search warrant under Section 97 BNSS to seize and return properties to bride.

title_en: Declaration of Legitimacy of Children of Voidable Marriages
relevant_act: Sec 16, Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
overall_steps_en: Produce child municipal birth certificate and certified copy of parents annulment/nullity decree. | File Declaratory Suit under Section 34 Specific Relief Act invoking statutory protection of Section 16 HMA. | Establish child was conceived prior to the date on which decree of nullity was passed. | Court enters judgment declaring child legitimate for all legal, social, and inheritance purposes.

title_en: Appointment of Court Guardian for Property of Minor Orphans
relevant_act: Sec 7 & 10, Guardians and Wards Act, 1890
overall_steps_en: Close relative files guardianship petition under Section 7 GWA before the District Judge. | Attach parents death certificates and detailed schedule of lands, bank FDs, and LIC policies. | District Judge issues citations in local newspapers and orders background verification of guardian. | Court issues Guardianship Certificate with strict bar on selling minor real estate without prior court nod.

title_en: Family Court Mandatory In-Camera Conciliation & Mediation
relevant_act: Sec 9 & 11, Family Courts Act, 1984
overall_steps_en: Family Court Judge refers active dispute to court mediation centre prior to framing trial issues. | Attend confidential in-camera sessions held in private chamber without external lawyers or media. | Judicial mediators assist parties in resolving alimony, child visitation, and division of jewelry. | If agreement is reached, execute Memorandum of Settlement ratified as an irrevocable court decree.
